Today we are not only focused on the creation of automated systems but also on creation of smart systems like smart homes, smart cities etc. This includes a lot of tasks to be done with the help of Internet of Things, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence etc. All these technologies are widely used in order to create a system which can be used to complete a task automatically with the need of any human effort. In such a technology driven society there is always a need to create a system which can be used to monitor the usage of water in different apartments of a building. The main problem here is that there is no way to know how much of water is used in different apartments of a building and the cost of installation of separate water meters is too high also it will need a lot of construction work to install it. Currently there is no system to which is efficient enough to complete this such type of task as it need human efforts at many stages. In this there is a need of creation a system which can be installed easily with very less or no construction also it should be able to collect data and then it should continuously stream whole data to server for processing and generate result in real time also, the overall cost should be low enough that it can be used commercially. In this paper we are focusing on creating a low-cost smart device which can be used to collect the data of water consumption. To achieve this, we have proposed to create a device with Arduino along with some sensors and modules to collect multiple data of water consumption from different apartments. After collecting this data this device will send this data to server with the help of a Wi-Fi module attached to the device. At the same time, we are using an Artificial Neural Network model for the analysis of this data for generating high accuracy results. Finally, these results will be shown on an Android App and Web App for better availability and better usability of the whole system which will allow the user to access it anywhere any time.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach for detection of the symptomatic patterns in the acoustic biological signal using Truncation Multiplier
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Design of low power systems become a preeminent role in the domain of VLSI. Various algorithms are being used to implement a reliable system. This paper discusses the diagnosis of various symptoms in the audio signal. Discrete Wavelet Transform is the mathematical block for the detection and analysis of the spectral components of an audio signal. The wavelet transform detects signal levels in the acoustic signal. These coefficients are further applied to mathematical blocks such as coastline, quasi-average and energy blocks to diagnosis symptoms respectively depending on the frequency ranges. The symptoms such as cough, sneeze having similar spectral ranges which are distinguish using Mel spectrum based analysis. The aim is to diagnosis the symptomatic patterns in human audio signals with low power design and area efficient computational architecture for the mathematical blocks. The proposed work employs the truncation multiplier design in the wavelet transform and energy parameter. Since the LSB parts are not required in the realization of the wavelet transform filters which reduce the power and area consumption thereby makes the design a power and area efficient system. It is observed a significant change in the power consumption <; 90% in the implementation. The system is implemented using Xilinx 14.5, ModelSim for the functionality and analysis of power.

articleTitle: An Iot Based Safety and Security Mechanism for Passenger Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Nowadays, we come across a lots of road accidents in our daily life. There are many reasons behind such accidents like rash driving, diminished vigilance level of driver, drunken driving etc.Though there are different models introduced for the safety and security, maintenance and implementation cost is high in these models. Here in this work we are proposing a simple prototype for real time monitoring of driver vigilance to avoid accidents using expression reading and using MQ sensors to identify any gas leakages and to identify whether the driver is alcoholic and to give real time alarm about the situation.

articleTitle: Space Vector PWM Scheme for Three Phase Three Level T-type NPC Inverter
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Multi-level inverters (MLI) have been widely used for dc to ac power conversion for different applications. Different PWM methods are used to control the multilevel inverters. Among various PWM methods, space vector pulse width modulation (SVPWM) is the superior method. As the number of level increases, the execution of space vector modulation (SVPWM) for multilevel inverters is difficult. In this paper a basic space vector modulation scheme is applied to three phase three level T-type NPC in which dwell time calculation is done for one sector only, and same can be mapped for other sectors. Simulation and experimental results are presented for performance validation.

articleTitle: Path Planning For Autonomous Car
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: The autonomous cars will transform the lifestyle of people by creating an efficient way of driving on roads. The ability to detect and track the stationary or the moving objects is said to be one of the major challenging tasks for decades. The research on object detection seems to be looking for a longterm vision in autonomous cars so that there is a significant enhancement in safety. The object detection is necessary for both day and night facilitating smooth transportation. In this paper, we are analyzing the images. The images classification algorithms are used such as a convolutional neural network (CNN). The algorithms will later be implemented on the graphical processing unit which will lead to the steering of the automobile based on the study of image recognition.

articleTitle: Intrusion Prevention System In RDBMS
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Data security is one of the major concern that worries individuals and organizations over the world. One approach to make data less vulnerable is to implement Intrusion Prevention System in databases. In this paper, we introduce an Intrusion Prevention System, using the concept of Counting Bloom Filters. Log Based Clustering algorithm is also used for prevention purpose. The system act as a middleware between the client application and database. Experiments were carried out with several databases which shows that our system can effectively prevent intrusions. Transactions identified as malicious by the system will get roll backed.

articleTitle: Leukocytes Classification and Segmentation in Microscopic Blood Smear Image
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Blood tests play an important role in the detection of various types of diseases. The problem arises when large quantities of blood samples need to be processed. As the number of samples increases, so does the risk of error. It limits the speed and precision of blood sampling. Blood cells can be divided into three types: Red blood cells (RBC), White blood cells (leukocytes) and platelets. Of these globules, white blood cells play an important role in disease detection because their conventional method of detecting and classifying white blood cells under the microscope is inaccurate and leads to the development of new methods. This paper presents an effective computer method for WBC classification. This method consists of three steps. They are preprocessing, segmentation and classification using an ANN classifier. The experiments were performed on 65 digital blood smear images of 5 different types of WBC cells.

articleTitle: Secure Mechanism for Communication Using Image Steganography
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: In this paper, we introduce a tactic to ensure secure data transmission over a network which has reformed the mode of transmitting data. A new method is recommended that combines the techniques of Steganography along with Cryptography considering a 24 bit color image. This is achieved using the Advanced Encryption Standard algorithm and Bit Plane Complexity Segmentation Steganography techniques. The process involves encrypting the secret message into a cipher text using AES algorithm, then embedding the encrypted text onto a cover image, then splitting the cover image into 2 images and encrypting the two images using the same AES algorithm to get two separate encrypted images. Finally these encrypted images are further embedded on the initial carrier image separately in order to get two stego images. The privacy of the message is achieved by making it almost impossible for a third party to detect and retrieve the hidden data.

articleTitle: Remote Fall Detection System for the Elderly
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Human fall detection is a major challenge in the healthcare domain. It is estimated that over a third of the population aged 65 years and above, fall each year, making it the most prominent cause of non-fatal injury in their age group. This hinders their sense of independence and increases the need for constant monitoring of their activities. Progress of technology helps facilitate implementation of wearable remote monitoring systems to help detect a fall and implement necessary measures to ensure appropriate medical assistance is provided. This paper outlines the implementation of such a system which helps in the detection of a fall and the notification of the required caretaker via an SMS containing the location of the fallen person, so as to provide timely medical attention.

articleTitle: A Survey on Hamming Codes for Error Detection
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Transferred information may gets damaged many-a-times during signal transmission. Therefore, the signals received by the receiver are erroneous and different to what the sender had originally sent. This paper provides a comparison between three different types of error detecting codes, all based on the basic hamming code principle. Each code has its own efficiency in the way it functions, its power/area consumption etc., and its own correction capabilities. In this paper we focus on the working of these three error detecting codes and try to find out the more effective one.<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1] [3] [4]</sup>

articleTitle: Non-contact Heart Rate Monitoring Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Health monitoring is an important parameter to determine the health status of a person. Measuring the heart rate is an easy way to gauge our health. Normal heart rate may vary from person to person and a usually high or low resting heart rate can be a sign of trouble. There are several methods for the measurement of heart rate monitoring such as ecg, ppg etc. Such methods having a disadvantage that these are invasive and have a continuous contact with the human body. In order to overcome this problem a new system is proposed using camera. In this method a blind source separation algorithm is used for extracting the heart rate signal from the face image. Viola jones based face detection algorithm is used to track the face. FastICA algorithm is exploited to separate heart rate signal from noise and artefacts. Machine learning algorithm is implemented to standardize the signal. The data is successfully tested with real time video.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Queries in RDBMS vs NoSQL
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Due to the enormous amount of information getting stored in databases, an extra effort is needed to handle the information so that it is not lost in any way. To avoid the loss of information various methods were introduced and one such technique is introduction of NoSQL using MongoDB. In this paper, a comparison is made between structured Oracle and an unstructured MongoDB, with few identified operations in a controlled environment. The result obtained is then used to realize better performance of the structured or unstructured methods.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Based Brain MRI Estimation Method
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: An unusual growth of brain cells within the brain is called as brain tumor. MRI is an highly developed medical imaging technique used to produce high quality images of human body parts and analyzing the body. Medical image processing plays an important role to give information in more extent for such advance images. This is done by applying various algorithms on the input image to extract detail information. Various classification and segmentation methods have been used by various researchers for this purpose. We propose a comparative analysis to opt the best classifier for automatic detection of medical severances of patients through MR image. It is also promoted the effect of a group of different texture features on basic and stage-wise classification.

articleTitle: SRR Loaded H-Shape Antenna for ECG Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: This paper described Split ring resonator loaded antenna H-shape antenna for electrocardiogram (ECG) monitoring application. The antenna designed through bio-tissue layers. The designed antenna operated at Industrial Scientific medical band (2.36 to 2.48) GHz and fifth generation medical service band (3.3 to 3.6) GHz. The simulated results of reflection coefficient are -27dB at 2.4GHz and -29dB at 3.5GHz for H-shaped configured antenna. The far-field results, reflection coefficient, and voltage standing wave ratio are presented.

Author Keywords: conductor backed coplanar wave guide CB-CPW

articleTitle: Detection of Counterfeit News Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Counterfeit news or hoax news has been one of the prevalent problems that global society has faced. The differentiation between counterfeit news and real news has stayed one of the hardest problems to tackle. The proposed system comes up with models of different machine learning techniques for differentiating fake news and real news. This approach utilizes four different models of machine learning: Neural Network, Naive Bayesian, Support Vector Machine (SVM) and Long and Short-Term Memory(LSTM). The dataset that we are using is obtained from Kaggle(Fake News). We start with text normalization of the data(news) in the dataset. Text normalization includes stopping words removing, removing punctuations and other diacritics, converting all letters to lowercase, etc. The second step is feature extraction. Doc2vec model is used in order to represent the data as feature vectors. These vectors are the inputs of Naive Bayes, SVM, Neural network and LSTM. Every one of these algorithms will be assessed to determine which algorithm will yield the most accurate result. Among the four algorithms, LSTM proved to be the best with an accuracy of (92%).

articleTitle: A Novel Approach on Error Detection and Correction using Feedforward Artificial Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: According to a Forbes survey around two and a half quintillion bytes of data is being created on the internet each day. With such a rate the amount of data to be structured is going to double in a time span of nearly one and a half years. It is not only the amount of data but the number of systems that communicate the data with each other increasing the complexity even further. With such a huge combination of data exchange possible, there is a high chance of erroneous data communication between communication channels. Though there are some hardware technologies like optical fiber which reduces such errors the cost for such systems is very high and impractical to implement on a full hundred percent scale. Moreover, with the current technology of error correction and reduction, the system is not immune to a large number of changes in the communication channel. If the number of bytes changes either in the data word or the appended code word the whole algorithm remains vulnerable. Hence in this paper, artificial neural networks are used to reduce the errors and make the system immune to a high number of changes in the data word or even the code word. This is achieved using artificial neural networks as an encryptor and doing overfitting of the data on the bytes. Since composite functions are created for every hidden layer of the neural system, therefore the change if a higher number of bytes does not affect the neural network output considerably and this forms the crux of this paper.

articleTitle: Capacitive Sensor for Level Measurement in Hopper/Silos - Experimental Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Hoppers and silos are the integrated part of various industrial processes. Hoppers or silos are used mainly as a temporary storage of the product or by-product from the industrial processes. Level measurement in hoppers is a crucial task due to temperature and dusty environment. Various techniques like optical laser based sensors, ultrasonic sensors, strain gauge based sensors etc. are used for level measurement in the hoppers/silos. But for cement or ash level measurement, due to dusty environment ultrasonic sensors and optical sensors are not advisable. Strain gauge based sensors are also not advisable as it work on the physical deformation of the sensor so it has relatively small life cycle. A non-contact type capacitive sensor design is proposed and experimentally evaluated for level measurement in hopper/silos. The calculation for the non-parallel portion of the hopper is also presented in this work. The present design in free from any parasitic capacitances and the outer metallic body of the hopper is used as shield for the capacitive sensor. The experiments are performed for cement clinkers and fly ash and the results are presented.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study And Analysis Of Lattice Boltzmann Method And Exemplar Method For Still Color Image Inpainting Technique
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Inpainting techniques are used for image restoration and object removal. In which restoration is a complicated and important area of research. Restoration of damaged regions of an image is done with the help of image inpainting techniques, so that the image looks natural, complete and beautiful for human eyes. Lattice Boltzmann Method and Exemplar methods are implemented here in color images which must be inpainted and a comparative analysis of the two methods on its variables are done. Exemplar based approaches perform well for two-dimensional textures. Image restoration is done using Lattice Boltzmann Method and Exemplar method in color image. The LBM scheme can also be considered as a special discretized form of the continuous Boltzmann equation. After implementation of inpainting techniques in the image their signal to noise ratio, image quality and time taken for execution is calculated and compared. From the result we have arrived a conclusion that Lattice Boltzmann Method gives a better physical appearance when compared to Exemplar method in image inpainting of color still images.

articleTitle: A Survey on Spam Review Detection and Recommendation of Superior Results in Netspam Framework
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Major Society of people using internet trust the contents of internet. The possibility that anyone can take survey about anything provides a great opportunity to spammers to make fake reviews about product, its services. So to identify the spammers and their spams is really a debatable issue for research and despite that there are many studies in this context yet none of them has a great significance. In this application, we use a structure, stated as NetSpam, which proposes spam features for giving a practical hotel review datasets to design a spam review detection method into a classification issue. Utilizing the role of spam features helps us to have good outcome in context of different metrics on review datasets. The results shows that NetSpam outcome with the previous methods and encompassed by features of the four categories; involving behavior and language of review feature, behavior and language of user feature, better outcomes can be obtained from first type of feature rather than other ones. The contribution work is when user will search query it will display all top products as well as there is recommendation of the product.

articleTitle: Modified Three Phase Multilevel Inverter with Reduced Number of DC Sources and Switches
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: This paper presents a modified three phase multilevel inverter with reduced number of DC sources and switches. The main objectives are to design and implement a multilevel inverter with reduced component count and to achieve reduced switching loss, size, cost and improved efficiency. Multilevel inverter is the core of this system. Multilevel inverters are used in the power system compensators and power quality conditioners to reduce the converter harmonics. But existing multilevel converters are having higher component count, high cost and high switching loss. The paper a modified multilevel inverter which will reduce the component count, thus increasing the efficiency, reducing the switching loss, size and cost. Matlab simulation based result proves the validity of the proposed system.

articleTitle: Three-Phase Single Stage Solar PV Integrated UPQC
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: In this paper, fractional open circuit algorithm based solar PV(photo-voltaic) integrated UPQC(unified power quality conditioner) is presented and its performance is analysed during steady state and dynamic conditions using Matlab Simulink software. In UPQC Shunt and series connected voltage source converters(VSC) are connected back to back having a dc link in common. Shunt compensator has dual functionality such as it extracts power from solar PV array and provide current compensation where as series compensator provides voltage compensation by injecting voltage(in phase/out of phase) into the grid through the point of common coupling during voltage sags/swells. Fractional open circuit algorithm with single stage topology is used for extracting power from PV array. Fractional open circuit algorithm is not only easy to impelement but also gives smooth and oscillation free responses. This system acts as a multifunctonal system by providing clean energy to the grid with improved Power quality.

articleTitle: VFD Control for Industrial Machines using PLC and LC Filter
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Variable frequency drive (VFD) and servo drive usage in the industrial application are increased in a large amount. The control of VFD can be done using a programmable logic controller (PLC). The apparatus includes a main controller i.e. VFD and first interface PLC. The motor controller (VFD) is coupled to the PLC and controls the electric motor according to the application. PLC is further coupled to Human Machine Interface (HMI) to show the operation visually. An input to VFD is given from the PLC to run the motor and outputs from the VFD is controlled frequencies, which control the speed and torque of a motor. Harmonics, motor bearing damage, motor noise, electromagnetic interference are observed in the pulse width modulated (PWM) VFD fed induction motor. A sinusoidal LC filter is placed between the VFD and motor to smoothen the pulse width modulated waves into sinusoidal waves, which basically reduces the noise and effectively improve the overall efficiency of VFD.

articleTitle: Disturbance Observer Based Formation Control Of Multi Agent System
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: In this paper, a novel method of disturbance observer based formation control using modified gradient control law for single integrator agents is proposed. Gradient control law involves defining a potential function which is the sum of squares of distance errors and the control law is derived from the negative gradient of this function. Modified gradient control law augments a number of virtual coordinates to the actual variables such that the formation problem is transferred into a higher dimensional plane. The potential function defined and gradient control law derived are with respect to the new variables. In real life situations, agents will be continuously subjected to disturbances and may fail to achieve formation. Hence, the objective of this work is to design an observer to estimate the disturbances and to manipulate the control effort appropriately so as to maintain the formation even in the presence of disturbances. The effectiveness of the theoretical results are validated using simulation.

articleTitle: Security Analysis of Hash Based Fragile Watermarking Scheme for Image Integrity
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: In this paper, we analyze the security vulnerabilities of hash based fragile watermarking method for image integrity proposed by Gul and Ozturk. The scheme divides the image into non-overlapping blocks of size 32 × 32 which is further subdivided into four sub-blocks of size 16 × 16. A 256 bit watermark generated using SHA-256 from first three sub-blocks is hidden into the fourth sub-block. Tampered blocks are identified by comparing extracted hash with computed hash value. We observe that this scheme is vulnerable to the modification of fourth subblock, swapping of image blocks, cropping attack, collage attack and vector quantization attack.

articleTitle: Smart Forest Surveillance Unit (S.F.S)
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: In this paper, investigation is done on developing an electronic based mechanism to deal with human-animal conflict, wildlife and illegal tree trafficking in the forest based zones. An electronic based automated system is designed to provide location i.e, tracking of wildlife, visitors, and the falling of trees is monitored using vibrational sensor. The system works without relying on internet, GPS or cellular communication except while using blink app features. Human-animal conflict is dealt by notifying the location to forest officials and instantaneously producing sound frequencies which irritates wild animals. Villages and agricultural fields nearby forest areas are also monitored to alert animal breaching and raiding of crops. The system is completely dynamic and provides a totally interface-able atmosphere to the forest officials. Furthermore, the whole system is developed with respective to the context of developing countries and is implemented at minimal costs.

articleTitle: Selection of Material for Magnetic Core of LVDT for High Temperature Application
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Linear variable differential transformer (LVDT) is widely used to measure the small displacements. It has many advantages over other displacement measuring transducers like potentiometer. This paper explores the characteristics of temperature dependency of LVDT. At higher temperature the output of the LVDT is generally altered. By suitable selection of the stable permeable material for the core of LVDT, the temperature dependency of the LVDT output can be minimized. The effect of temperature on the permeability of the core of LVDT and output is studied in this work using the COMSOL Multiphysics software.

articleTitle: Designing of anti-windup feature for internal model controller with real-time performance evaluation on temperature control loop
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: In this study a new designing methodology of internal model controller with anti-windup feature is suggested. Due to presence of integral action in the conventional internal model controller (IMC) structure reset windup effect is found quite often. This limitation can be overcome by incorporating the proposed anti-windup scheme. Efficacy of the reported technique is experimentally verified on a temperature control set-up manufactured by Quanser [22].

articleTitle: Blocking Artifacts Removal of DCT based Highly Compressed Images
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: In this paper, an adaptive method of removing the blocking artifacts from JPG standard based highly compressed images have been presented. In the case of JPG based highly compressed images, there is always the appearance of some boundary like artifacts called Blocking artifacts. It is always necessary to remove these type of artifacts. Therefore, in order to remove all these artifacts, a post-de-blocking method is essential. In the proposed work, to remove these blocking artifacts an adaptive method which is based on local content has been used. The simulation results of the considered method have been compared with other methods based on MSSIM, PSNR, MSE, where the proposed method has performed better than other methods.

articleTitle: Lane Detection and Lane Departure Warning System using Color Detection Sensor
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: The vision-based Lane Detection and Departure Warning System is an effective way to prevent road accidents and ensure vehicle safety. However, in order to provide accurate and fast lane detection, it is very important to select state of art in image processing method. Lane detection and lane departure warning system have been the most important feature in Advanced Driving Assistance Systems (ADAS). It is a critical system, Which is used to improve road as well as vehicle safety. The proposed feature is evaluated in detail using real world lane data through camera,used for faster decision making system. Which have been Hough Transform and Canny's Edge detection algorithm, uses along with color detection sensor, in order to detect Lane.

articleTitle: Modelling and analysis of grid-integrated solar system with power management scheme using battery
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: The paper is based on the modelling and design of the grid-integrated solar system with power management system using battery. The efficiency of the system is increases by the incremental conductance MPPT algorithm. The battery connected power management scheme provide a constant and valid power output from solar radiations regardless of the continuous variation in PV radiations. The power management exploits a buck-boost (bidirectional) DC-DC converters to manage charging and release condition of batteries. DC power from solar cell is converted to AC power by using the single phase Inverter. Low pass LC filter is used to sustain the higher frequency components.

articleTitle: Battery Charger for Electric Vehicles with Modified Power Factor Corrected Bridgeless Converter
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: This paper presents modified bridgeless single-stage converter to charge light Electric vehicle (EV) battery. The main aim is to improve the efficiency and attain the Unity Power Factor (UPF) of the bridgeless converter for battery charger. The converter has a single stage power conversion with tapped inductor boost converter. The converter is having a bridgeless configuration that minimizes the conduction losses of the input diodes. In this configuration the voltage is boosted using the converter and easily charge the EV battery. In two-stage converter the losses are more, and the configuration is bulky. In the proposed charger the conduction losses can be reduced, attain voltage gain, PF and efficiency can be improved. Hence the single stage bridgeless converter with boost converter based on tapped inductor is used to improve the above-mentioned parameters. The existing and modified system is verified using MATLAB Simulink software and the results proves the effectiveness of the charger.

articleTitle: Analysis of Different cases of Blurs in Images Using the Concept of Key points
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Photos are a means to keep our beautiful memories. Although we have high-resolution cameras nowadays, blurs in images is a common phenomenon. Blurriness can be of various reasons, as they may be caused due to defocus or can be due to focusing on specific objects. So the types of blurs in images are analyzed. Blur analysis becomes vital when they are being enhanced. During image enhancement, enhancing highly sharp or highly blurred image region produce obnoxious results. Firstly, types of blurs, mainly motion blur and defocus blurs are analyzed. Then key points of images are detected. Matching of key points is done for a visual analysis as well as a match metric value is assessed to detect the deviation of interest points from the original image. Also, a blur percentage is calculated as well as a histogram metric is evaluated.

articleTitle: Design a Heart shaped Dielectric Resonator Antenna for Triple Band Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: A heart shaped Dielectric Resonator Antenna is proposed in this paper. In this work, the DRA covers the triple band response with WLAN, C-Band and X-Band applications. The WLAN provides the peak gain of 7.50dBi with return loss of -26.7dB and with minimum VSWR OF 1.14. The resonant frequency of WLAN, C-Band and X-Band is 5.2GHz, 6.5GHz, 11.1GHz respectively. The DRA is fed by micro strip line techniques. The tool used to simulated this model is Computer Simulation Techniques (CST).

articleTitle: Design and operation of 20KW bidirectional DC-DC converter and comparison of different topologies
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Today Electrical Vehicles are trending the market and hence an efficient charger for these EV's has become a necessity. The DC-DC converter is an important sub-circuit in this charger. Therefore, the need to improve the performance and efficiency of this converter has become important. This paper talks about the operation and design of an isolated DC-DC converter (DAB) for electric vehicle charger application. The different modes of operation at different load conditions are discussed. Also a comparative study of DAB with CLLC circuit is done. Design and mathematical modelling is validated by simulating in MATLAB.

articleTitle: Enhanced Face Recognition System Using Age Invariant Features
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Automatic face recognition system poses a various difficult problem using different age faces. Mostly face recognitions have addressed variation in ages problems like age simulation or age estimation. Age invariant is a complex procedure that influences both face texture and the shape of face. In automatic face recognition system these texture and shape changes degrade the performance. The problem is designing an effective matching framework of face recognition system using different images of aging. In this paper to develop a model for automatic age invariant face recognition model using facial features. In the model, extract the facial features like eye, mouth and nose in the given image based on the illumination method. Once the eye, nose, and mouth are detected, need for aligning the face. The face alignment depends on the angle between the eye and mouth coordinates. Once the face alignment completed, calculate the eigenvalue and eigenvectors of co-variance matrix. Then find difference between all features to get a difference vector. The eigenfaces calculates the eigenvalues and eigenvectors. Compare these distance vectors for all faces to get a most match value or minimum mismatch value. Give the face with the most matches or minimum mismatch value as the output. The results of various experiments shows that this method outperforms the usage of the face aging data sets of IFDA. A fusion of age invariant face recognition using facial features model further improves the accuracy of the face matching in the presence of aging.

articleTitle: Application of FPGA in the Electric Customer Service Hall
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: This article first investigates the existing application status of FPGA in power system, and finds that the current application relies more on the hardware advantages and characteristics of FPGA. Then it discusses the application scenarios in electric power customer service of FPGA combined with artificial intelligence technology, including the service quality inspection of the staff, the behavior monitoring of non-staff, the monitoring of the operational status of the service hall equipment and the carrying capacity of the service hall window. Finally, it analyzes the difficulties to be solved of the FPGA application in power customer service. The solutions includes data accumulation for related samples, algorithms and model optimization for corresponding scenarios and light-weighting model to better adapt to low-power consumption requirement for FPGA hardware.

articleTitle: Isolated Boost Converter with Transformerless Microinverter for Single Phase Standalone Solar System
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Transformerless micro-inverter powered by an isolated boost converter for single phase solar photovoltaic system is suggested in this paper. The first step of system consists of an isolated boost converter and the second stage consists of transformerless micro-inverter. The isolated boost converter provides the desired output voltage using maximum power point tracking (MPPT) algorithm. Additionally, in absence of solar energy, the system is operated in battery-only mode or power-off mode in the absence of both energy sources. The transformerless inverter in the second stage of the system uses a flying capacitor principle. Overall the system has only six switches, two for boost converter and four for micro-inverter. It overcomes the problem of leakage current as compared to conventional micro-inverter topologies. The simulation for the proposed system is executed in MATLAB/Simulink. The results gives effectiveness of system.

articleTitle: Region of Interest Based Comparative Analysis in Deception Detection using Thermal Images
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: The criminal mind is never at rest. Individuals with malicious intent are constantly devising new strategies to disrupt peace and tranquility. It is therefore necessary for the Law and Order officials to remain vigilant and develop new strategies to restore peace. Information especially the ones provided by witnesses, victims, captured perpetrators etc., play a vital role in development of such strategies. Thus it is of utmost importance to ensure that the information obtained is accurate. Traditional methods of deception detection like polygraph tests, even though widely used, do not produce reliable results. Recent studies show that the thermal characteristics of certain facial regions such as nose and pre-orbital. Therefore, with this project our aim is to find out which region of interest provides better result in predicting the deceptiveness in humans.

articleTitle: Experiments on Malayalam Language using Graph-based Data-driven Dependency Parser
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: The Malayalam language possesses characteristics like morphological richness and agglutination, which makes the processing of language a tiresome task. The resources like treebank allow the syntactic-semantic analysis of Malayalam. In this work, the validation and optimization of Malayalam Treebank Data_ Iiithwere done with various parsing settings. The improvement in the values of qualitative analysis metrics was the main result of the optimization experiments. 10-cross-validation of the data was also performed for the analysis of the attainment of models generated. The results were found to be promising.

articleTitle: Enhanced half rule based model reduction scheme for higher-order processes
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Presently, model based PID (proportional-integral-derivative) tuning techniques are widely employed in process industries due to their easy understanding and straightforward guidelines. Majority of the industrial processes are modeled as first-order-plus-dead-time (FOPDT) form. But, in practice most of the processes are higher-order and hence suitable realization of such processes in FOPDT form is a challenging task. Skogestad half rule [7] technique is a well established mechanism for reduction of higher-order processes with a goal towards model based PID controller designing. A modification has been proposed here in the reported half rule based model reduction scheme. Efficacy of the proposed model reduction based close-loop response is verified on a number of well-known higher-order process models. Moreover, its robustness has also been established with considerable perturbation in process model parameters.

articleTitle: A New Discrete Reaching Law for Discrete-time Sliding Mode Control
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: In this paper, a novel reaching law for discrete time sliding mode control is proposed. The law aims at reducing the width of quasi sliding mode band as well as fast reaching of the sliding variable to the sliding surface. While there are many existing reaching laws that give rise to an accelerated reaching phase, they often engender an initial spike in the control effort. This problem is addressed in the paper by defining a reaching law that regulates the rate of change of the sliding variable in such a way as to curtail the control effort. The proposed reaching law, when compared to the well established reaching law proposed first by Gao, Homaifa and Wang, leads to faster reaching with smaller Quasi Sliding Mode Band while maintaining the same control effort. The efficacy of the proposed reaching law has been verified through simulations and compared with the simulation results obtained for Gao's reaching law to illustrate its various advantages.

articleTitle: AC Grid Connected PV System with Autonomous Operation Using V (Q) AND F (P) Control Strategy
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: This paper presents the distribution AC grid is connected to photovoltaic system is based on voltage and frequency control strategy. Magnitude and speed are controlled at point of common coupling (PCC) using voltage -frequency control strategy in autonomous mode and p-q control strategy in grid connected mode. The PCC space vector is the comparison of the reference space vector that is simultaneously applied towards the PCC to extract the disturbance. The V(Q)-F(P) control strategy provide the active and reactive power generate., in response to voltage and frequency deviation. The voltage and frequency control strategy are applicable for single and three phase converter interfaced with energy system.

Author Keywords: Point of common coupling (PCC) space vector

articleTitle: Modified Design and Analysis of Constant Voltage Hot Wire Anemometer
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: In general, Hot-Wire Anemometers (HWA) are used to measure the local, instantaneous velocity of fluid based on the principles of heat transfer. A modification in the existing Constant Voltage Anemometer (CVA) circuit have been proposed in this paper. The design modification add the features, using which global, average velocity of air can be measured. The proposed circuit is extremely simple and low-cost; which only add to its suitability for use in more applications, study and industries. The Constant voltage HWA (CV-HWA) was analyzed using CFD, analytically and theoretically; and the results concur with the proposed claims. The head loss due to the HWA acting as an obstruction to flow was also studied. The stress-strain study on the HWA due to the flow is also studied and taken into account for analysis.

articleTitle: An Inter User Image Re-Ranking System
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Nowadays, a number of images has been shared across the social network platform comprising of both relevant and irrelevant images. To find the relevant images,are too hard for a normal user. The IUIR(Inter User Image Re-ranking) system aimed to find those relevant images. The inter user image re-ranking system helps to detect accurate pictures and the contribution of each social users data. IUIR is applicable to find more accurate and quality images and for query related image retrieval with the consideration of images relevance and diversity. Re ranking image informations consist of visually, semantically and click count of images. The ranking of the user with highest contribution is retrieved first, then the similar images are removed by the feature extraction and the resulting dissimilar image set are ranked by click count and the resulting set is the final retrieved result.

articleTitle: Consent based Access Control Mechanism for Encrypted Medical Image
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: An outline which defends tolerant details during facts transfer be necessary for medical management systems. On the way to attain safety and confidentiality for facts transfer, a consent based access control system was proposed. It grants the agreement by distributing token to the data client, where the permission can only be created by official client. Thus the information stored inside the data centre can be accessed only when the data requester has the token, which is similar to the token already present inside the data centre. If the confirmation of data centre is valid, the data requester can access the original information of the user. Eventually, the user will be notified by the data centre to deserve that there is no misuse outside consent. The anticipated consent based access control method is compared with existing methods to achieve less time utilization.

articleTitle: A Single Switch Multiple Step Gain Converter for Solar PV Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: In this writeup a new converter having multiple step-gain voltage output for solar PV applications is introduced. The proposed converter is an improved buck-boost converter and its voltage gain is expandable. The gain is higher when compared to conventional converters such as ordinary boost,ZETA, SEPIC and Cuk converters, for a specific duty ratio. This converter makes use of only one power switch. Also the voltage stress across it is low. As the converter has only single switch, it is easy to control, and implement MPPT(maximum power point tracking) to it, thereby providing maximum output of the most available renewable energy resource. Incremental Conductance MPPT control is used along with this converter for MPP tracking, desirable for solar PV applications. N level voltage output can be obtained from this same converter by repeatedly following the same topology. The converter is also capable of supplying power to the connected loads at all its port at various voltage levels. Ordinary switches are used to separate different volage levels. The operating principle and the mathematical analysis for voltage gain and output current of the proposed converter are discussed. Simulation results with InCond MPPT and converter hardware are presented to validate the designed converter and its working.

articleTitle: Image Classification based on t-Linear Combination of Tensor
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: A multidimensional linear algebra based image classification technique is proposed in this paper. The image on a particular class can be represented as a t-linear combination of images belong to same class whereas it is difficult to represent it using images in other classes. Motivated by this concept, the proposed method constructs tensors which provide approximate representation of each class during the training process. Lateral slices of these tensors are the images belongs to each class. In the next step, the strength of the representation coefficient is measured to determine the class where the image belongs. To achieve this, the proposed method computes a projection operator on to the set of subspaces throughout the learning process. Conventional method uses vectorization of images to form a data matrix. In contrast, the proposed method represents each class as a tensor for the effective utilization of structural information contained in the image samples. Feature extraction and classification is done in a single step. Moreover when compared to the predecessor, the proposed method requires a single projection operator which reduces the computational time to a large extent. The experimental results demonstrate the superiority of the proposed method over the existing method.

articleTitle: Joint Enhancement and Restoration of Underwater Images Using Reflectance and Illumination Components
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Underwater images are usually suffering from visibility issues like low brightness and low contrast. This is mainly resulted from attenuation of light in the imaging medium by absorption and scattering. In this paper, a joint restoration and enhancement algorithm for improving the quality of underwater images is proposed. Here degraded underwater image is decomposed to reflectance and illumination components. Red channel prior based restoration is applied to the illumination component. The reflectance component is enhanced by Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization (CLAHE) and color correction. The contrast and color fidelity improved underwater images is computed by multi-scale wavelet based image fusion of restored and enhanced images. Comparative analysis of the proposed technique is done with the existing techniques both quantitatively and qualitatively. A non-reference metric (underwater image quality measure (UIQM)) is used for evaluating the performance of the proposed method quantitatively. The experimental results reveals that the proposed algorithm effectively enhances the quality of underwater images.

articleTitle: Adaptive and Non-Adaptive Bandwidth Allocation Schemes for Call Admission Control in Cellular Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Day by day number of cellular network users is increased and resources are limited therefore the quality of service is reduced. Effective techniques for admitting subscribers into systems, with the available resources must be developed for better quality. For non real time traffic QoS requirement is not strict as it is required for real time traffic calls. So some bandwidth from non real time traffic may be released and used for real time traffic calls. Call admission control algorithm is developed for cellular system i. e. adaptive call admission control algorithm. In adaptive system algorithm bandwidth allocated to the existing call is dynamically adjusted by bandwidth up gradation and degradation. This scheme decreases call blocking probability. Also non adaptive schemes are compared. Thus call admission control schemes is designed to provide quality service and satisfaction to the mobile users.

Author Keywords: Adaptive and non adaptive bandwidth allocation

articleTitle: A Review On Recent Approaches to Recommendation System Model Using Distinct Product Features
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Recently, area of recommendation systems have achieved great popularity due to its applicability in the various business domains. Recommendation is an information filtering problem along with some criteria on the basis of which usefulness of an item is decided for a particular user. Each of the criteria defines the separate class of the recommendation problem i.e. collaborative filtering, content-based filtering, and hybrid recommendation systems. In this article, we first discuss the applicability of the recommendation systems in multiple areas. We also discuss the importance of item features in making recommendations more relevant. Next, we discuss the baseline models for content based, collaborative based filtering.

articleTitle: Comparison of digital image denoising method using various Transforms on Satellite Imagery
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Satellite imagery normally affected by Gaussian, speckle, Poisson and salt & pepper noise that occurred in images of different background and qualities with random variation over the pixels of the images. Removal of these noises from a digital image is an important task for scientist and engineers. Image de-noising is a basic problem in digital image processing particularly satellite images. There are several image de-noising methods are proposed. The aim of this paper is to study various de-noising methods using wavelet transform. Further, a relative examination has been made between Daubechies, Haar, Symlet and coiflet wavelets to get most reasonable outcomes utilizing wavelets image de-noising techniques with reference to satellite pictures. Execution of image de-noising technique is estimated utilizing quantitative parameters, for example peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR), mean square error (MSE) and structural similarity index (SSIM).

articleTitle: Speed Control For Indirect Vector Control Of Induction Motor Drives At Low Speeds
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Use of induction motor (IM) at it's highest efficiency is a big demanding task because of their complex mathematical model and non linear features during saturation. These elements make the control of IM strenuous and call for the use of high performance control algorithm such as field orientation control. This paper introduces a speed controller, particularly at minimum speeds by utilizing Fuzzy logic controller (FLC) for indirect field-oriented control (IFOC) of induction motor (IM) drives fed by a four-switch three-phase (FSTP) inverter. From suggested viewpoint, the IM drive is used with a FSTP inverter as an alternative for the conventional six-switch three-phase (SSTP) inverter. Utter IFOC programme includes the FLC of IM drives with the suggested FSTP inverter is raised in MATLAB/Simulink. By considering the good dynamic performance, cost minimization and low total harmonic distortion (THD), FSTP inverters are comparable with SSTP inverters. The dynamic performance and robustness of proposed FLC with the FSTP inverter fed IM drive is verified with PI controller. It is established that the suggested FLC is further powerful than the PI controller under speed tracking and load disturbances

articleTitle: Modelling of Biological Lower Extremity
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: The work done in this paper is an effort to study the leg movements during walking in order to motivate the design of biological leg efficiently and modelling of biological leg. Hypothesize that the leg comprising of two links represents femur and shank. For modelling, the biological leg is treated as a serial two link manipulator. The leg modelling is done using inverse dynamics with Lagrangian formulation approach and merged some virtual work concept to incorporate the ground reaction forces occurs in the gait cycle. For the development of the parameters, the data acquired is processed through mathematical equations using MATLAB/SIMULINK tool for precision and reliability. Leg model is constructed using different kinematic and kinetic input from gait experiments to provide output in the form of knee and hip torque. Complete and simplified model is introduced and determined torque is validated with experimental data.

articleTitle: Hybrid Interference Alignment (IA) Scheme for Improving the Sum-Rate of HetNet Users
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a hybrid Interference Alignment (IA) scheme for early detection of signal leakage to improve the sum rate of user cells in Heterogeneous Networks (HetNets). In the hybrid sceheme, Gaussian-Newton (GN) model is employed for estimating the signal at the receiver end. This model classifies the signal in Jacobian and Hessain Matrix representations to detect the interference and hence to improve the degree of freedom (DOF). The update variations are precisely classified using the vector representations using the above matrix representations to detect the leakage through classification at an early stage. This helps to improve the sum rate in HetNet environment with earlier convergence. The proposed hybrid IA in HetNets is found to detect leakage at a less convergence so as to improve sum rate.

articleTitle: A QoS Value Prediction for Web Services Using Ethical User Identification
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: When you use a web service, Our primary Consideration is the assurance we can gain by using the web service. Therefore the user should select the relevant web services, which can be easily managed. The Quality Of Service (QoS) value of web services determines the quality services up to a limit. QoS relates to multiple web service quality elements such as response time, throughput, packet loss etc. Assessing QoS have become a significant feature in building ethical service application. In our approach we first checks for missing fields in the dataset and by different levels of calculation we predict the missing values and fills the dataset and produces the output. It is evaluated based on QoS values given by the ethical users, who are identified by calculating the Prominence value of users. The system attempts to relegate the impact of unreliable feedbacks provided by dishonest users which affects the accuracy of QoS prediction. The predicted results proved to be accurate as the error rate is less, when the result is tested with Mean Absolute Error (MAE).

articleTitle: A Novel Method For Haze Detection In Color Images
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Nowadays quality of outdoor as well as indoor images are very important. But outdoor images are deteriorated by haze, fog, rain etc. These atmosphere conditions are adversely affects the visibility of the images and reduces the contrast. It is very much adverse in applications especially in military. Image dehazing algorithm are commonly used to restore the original image which is affected by haze. Fine details in the images are lost due to haze Herein, an algorithm for detection of haze using different classifiers has been implemented. In this work we used Dark channel prior technique for haze detection. In this work initially a number of image features are estimated to train different classifiers such as support vector machine, logistic regression and naïve Bayes Classifiers. In this work we compared Area under the curve of different classifiers.

articleTitle: Clock Gating Integration Using 18T-TSPC Clocked Flip Flop
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Flip-flops are a standout among the most significant and fundamental block of any advanced circuits. The power being on the main consideration in planning of the advanced circuits must be enhanced to improve the exhibition of the circuit. There are many low power techniques accessible to diminish the power dispersal. The thought here is to join the low power systems to request to get further power decrease plan. The Objectives of the project is to compare various design techniques such as Conventional C2MOS M-S FF architecture, Topologically Compressed Flip Flop, Logic Structure Reduction Flip Flop, True single-phase clock 18T FF (20T with Reset). Comparison is performed depending upon the various parameters such has average power, delay and PDP. Depending on the least power consumed by each of these logic design, low power techniques are applied i.e. multi V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">DD</sub> technique and clock gating technique. The cadence virtuoso tool is used for the implementation of the circuit and the technology used is 45nm. Extensive Simulations were conducted, and average power, delay and PDP of each of the logic design techniques were calculated. It was observed that 18T-TSPC consumes least amount of power. Low power optimization techniques were applied i.e. multi V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">DD</sub>and clock gating and it was observed to be 90% reduction in average power when applied with multi V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">DD.</sub>And 42.83% reduction of power when applied with clock gating technique.

articleTitle: Clean and Hygienic Automated Butter Extractor for Households
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Conventionally, Butter is prepared by hand in butter churns. It is a time consuming and wearisome process. The suggested practice focuses in automating the butter separation process, so that the separation can be done in less time and with increased efficiency, without the use of any chemicals or enzymes. The inputs given to the prototype is milk and the outputs are Skimmed milk, Buttermilk and Butter. The procedure is automated using the microcontroller Arduino Uno. Microcontroller is provided for controlling the timing for setting of the cream, valve operation, operating the agitator etc. A cleaning mechanism is also provided in the prototype to ensure hygiene and safety of users. Communication between the model and the consumer is also prearranged to ensure its user friendliness.

articleTitle: Ambient Intelligence In day to day life: A survey
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: There is a huge amount of data available in cloud, and mobiles connected to them, now connecting it to the physical world gives rise to internet of things. These things could be chair, table, clothes, vehicles, animals, plants, anything. The data gathered from these connected devices could be used to optimize and analyze data to build better and healthier environment around us, by combining internet of things with Ambient intelligence. Thus making the ambience intelligent i.e. Ambient Intelligence. We could connect with things, monitor things, and even search for items more easily. The developing field of Ambient intelligence is a comprehensive cutting-edge discipline. We have witnessed more practical and user-centered technologies like virtual and augmented reality, in the last decade. Now current trends are going to affect our lives socially and professionally. Here Ambient Intelligence (AmI) is an environment with electronic sensors that is responsive to human presence. It supports the design of intelligent systems and introduces sensors and processors to harmonize between people and machine. In this paper we are going to talk about AmI in health care industry, Smart Homes and also there use in Shopping Malls.

articleTitle: Unique Group Key Establishment Scheme for Internet of Thing
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: This paper is part of a research which the authors are carrying out for designing a secured transmission for IoT (Internet of Things). In this scenario group key plays a major role as vehicles would be grouped according to their size. A unique group key establishment system has been proposed where High Definition images(HDRI) are taken as a group key, the images are first watermarked using DWT and then encrypted and are assigned to each group. To access a device(source) of a group the key stored for the source is transmitted to the target trying to establish a connection. The target would be having the decryption algorithm where the image would be decrypted and the watermarked image is extracted and matched with the stored image, once a match is found the connection would be established between the source and the target but to access the device of the source target would again have to establish a simple device key authentication after which a complete connectivity would be possible. The proposed system is unique as there is no decryption key and uses images for authentication. It is the future of a secured IoT and networking as a whole. To check the robustness of the system various attacks including Man in the middle have been tried and quality of the extracted watermarked images has also been checked and it has been observed that the quality remains good even after transmitting the images in a linear form over the network.

articleTitle: A wavelet based time-frequency descriptor for automatic classification of acoustic signals of fishes
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Fishes are capable of emitting sounds for diverse purposes, which can be recorded through microphone sensors. This work aims to develop a methodology for automatic classification of fishes through their acoustic signals by applying pattern recognition techniques. Fish sounds are preprocessed and segmented automatically to extract each call. These calls are parametrized using local wavelet acoustic pattern (LWAP) and approximation coefficients obtained using wavelet decomposition, to yield useful information for classification. Three machine learning algorithms: discriminant analysis (DA), k- nearest neighbors (k-NN) and support vector machines (SVM) are used for the fish call identification. Syllables are identified with accuracies of 84, 89 and 56 percentages for DA, k-NN and SVM classifiers.

articleTitle: Unsupervised Change Detection in Remote Sensing Images using Multi-View Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: The geospatial objects laying on the earth surfaces are changing rapidly due to various reasons. The multi-temporal remote sensing images are widely used data sources to capture changed occurred at a particular location. Change detection is the process to determine disagreement in the nature of geospatial objects of the same location from different time's instances. Unsupervised change detection is an approach to determine the changed and unchanged state of a location without using any label information. The remote sensing images are captured in multiple spectral bands and the extraction of spatial, texture and shape features in each band increases the dimensionality of the data sets. The conventional change detection techniques may perform poor for the high dimensional remote sensing data sets. In this work, a multi-view learning based unsupervised technique has been developed for the unsupervised change detection in temporal remote sensing images. The experimental results on the two benchmark data sets show that the proposed unsupervised multi-view approach has performed better than single view unsupervised change detection techniques.

articleTitle: Leakage Reduction Tehniques in SRAM
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: As technology is advancing, there is a growing need for low voltage, high speed and better performance in devices. This results in increase in chip density and increase in operating frequency. Scaling down of threshold voltage contributes enormously to increase in sub threshold leakage current. Since most of the modern-day devices employ memory cells, there is an inevitable need to design low power and highspeed cells for better performance whilst retaining data stored. Furthermore, most of the portable devices like Laptops essentially require that their processors be run on low power. There have been several methods employed in the past to reduce sub threshold leakage current. Since Leakage Current flows during the off state of a device, many mechanisms have been introduced in the past that operate in this state to reduce leakage. Most of these techniques employ a method to cut off power supply to devices during tis off state. While these proved to lower the leakage power during this state, for memory devices, data stored can easily be lost during this state. Several techniques are proposed in this paper to overcome the leakage problem and the optimum technique is used to implement a 4×4 array along with peripherals. The techniques are compared based on leakage current, delays and SNM. The work is carried out in Cadence tool using Fin-FET technology and simulations done using HSPICE.

articleTitle: Real-Time Incremental Clustering on Social Network Comment Streams using Enhanced IncreSTS Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Popularity of social networking sites increases day by day. Due to its high popularity, the number of comments can grow at a high rate when a social message published. The users of social networking sites may wish to get a brief knowledge of comment streams without reading the all comments. The system aim to group comments with similar opinion together and create a summary for this message after filtering abusive words from each generated comments. Since the users will request the summary at any moment, we use IncreSTS algorithm for realtime incremental clustering of social network comment streams. Besides, we extract key-terms from each clusters that help users to easily get an overview summary.

articleTitle: Analysis of Recent Challenges and Solutions in Network Security
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Nowadays, a network management becomes more challengeable one comparing to previous years. some of the network management challenges are Preventing the network from the various attacks like ARP Spoofing, SYN Flood attack, providing higher Security to network servers by configuring Network Address Translation, De-Militarized Zone, preventing un-authorized access to the research journal websites, Managing Centralized logs for networking devices like networking switches, routers, Providing internet facility to all the network users without any issues and Threat Management. By implementing various recent techniques in the networks, the above issues are fixed and network becomes stable in all the times.

articleTitle: Switched Capacitor Converter for Solar Powered BLDC Motor Driven Water Pump
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Renewable energy sources are increasingly used in many applications due to the depleting nature of the present energy sources as well as the increased pollution caused by them. Out of the renewable energy sources solar Photovoltaic(SPV) is the most promising one due to its availability at most of the places and cleanliness. As the voltage available from PV panel is insufficient to drive the motor pump set, a high gain highly efficient DC-DC converter is essential to boost up the voltage. This paper presents a switched capacitor converter for BLDC Motor driven water pump fed from solar PV. The switched capacitor converter is selected due to its high voltage gain, low device stresses, low input and output current ripple. An incremental conductance maximum power point tracking (INC MPPT) algorithm is incorporated along with the SC converter for extracting maximum solar energy. A brushless DC (BLDC) motor is used to drive a centrifugal pump which provides less maintenance, high efficiency and high reliability. The BLDC motor is controlled by the electronic commutation scheme in which switching pulses to the voltage source inverter(VSI) is produced according to the hall sensor signals. The behavior of proposed system is evaluated through MATLAB/simulink based simulation study. The entire system is analysed at various irradiation conditions. It is found that the system is effective even at low irradiation level as 200 W/ m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Modelling and Fourth-order consensus of Flexible Link Manipulators
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: A pre-programmed system composed of intelligent agents, which is designed to carry out a task that would be difficult for an individual agent to do is called a multi agent system. These agents as a group performs better than their individual counter parts. The control of all the agents in the system is a complicated quest in which extensive research is being done. There are many different ways towards controlling the information flow between the agents, of which distributed approach is gaining importance due to its robustness, adaptivity, flexibility and scalability. Consensus is a distributed control approach in which the agents work together to reach a common goal. This paper gives a consensus control algorithm which can be used to control a homogenous system, which is in this case a system composed of flexible link manipulators.

articleTitle: A Novel Technique for Biometric Data Protection in Remote Authentication System
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Remote authentication via biometric features has received much attention recently, hence the security of biometric data is of great importance. Here a crypto-steganography method applied for the protection of biometric data is implemented. It include semantic segmentation, chaotic encryption, data hiding and fingerprint recognition to avoid the risk of spoofing attacks. Semantically segmented image of the person to be authenticated is used as the cover image and chaotic encrypted fingerprint image is used as secret image here. Chaotic encrypted fingerprint image is embedded into the cover image using Integer Wavelet Transform (IWT). Extracted fingerprint image is then compared with the fingerprints in database to authenticate the person. Qualified Significant Wavelet Trees (QSWT`s) of the cover image act as the target coefficients to insert the secret image.
