abstract: Image Fusion is an application of digital image processing. Image Fusion is a phenomenon of amalgamating the substantial features from similar pair of images into a single image, where the fused image will be of superior quality than either of the source images. This research work proposes a Pixel level Deep learning method using a 3-Channel convolutional neural network to fuse two multi focus Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) images obtain a high definition or high quality fused image. As the environment is in static condition and the radar is in floating, the radar imagery sensor captures source image at different time stamps. Size reduction of the image is performed before the fusion procedure in order to highly reduce the computational time and make the method more immune to noise. In the proposed method, source images are decomposed into pixels using the deep learning framework. After feature extraction, appropriate weights are assigned to all pixels. Then averaging and max pooling of pixel values of both the source images are done to get the resultant features of the fused image. Then smoothening filter is used to minimize noise in the fused image. Experimental results show that the proposed fusion technique demonstrates better PSNR value and less computational time.

articleTitle: Obstacle Avoidance Mechanism for Transmission Line Inspection Robot
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: In this paper, a robot which can travel on over head cables and overcome spacers, suspension clamps and other obstacles is proposed for power transmission line inspection. Power supply security and reliability are two major concerns of any power industry. Regular inspection of power transmission line equipment is necessary to ensure an uninterrupted transmission. Manual inspection is time consuming and involves risk of injuries and even loss of life. Hence alternative to manual inspection is necessary and always appreciated. The robot is teli- operated and it has intelligence to protect itself from colliding with any object which may come across it. With three arms and flexible joints it can negotiate obstacles like spacers and suspension clamps. A counter weight mechanism is provided for center of mass adjustment of the robot body while the obstacle avoidance. Accelerometer and Gyroscope are used as orientation sensors. A number of infrared distance sensors are used for obstacle detection.

articleTitle: Non-linear Dynamical Analysis of an Inverted Pendulum Cart Mechanism using Bifurcation Method
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: This paper presents the innate behavior of an Inverted Pendulum, which is an iconic symbol for nonlinear, unstable, underactuated, non-minimum-phase, non-holonomic multi-variable, fourth order system, etc. These characters, exhibited by the model plays a vital role in various fields of Engineering and Science. What makes them interesting is the Topological properties owned by the equilibrium points, in an Inverted Pendulum. The rigorous investment of Topology via techniques from Bifurcation Theory is presented here. This helps, one to gain intuition about the behavior of complex dynamical systems, from a quantum level to macroscopic systems.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach Based on Gesture Recognition through Video Capturing for Sign Language
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Communication is an important life skill which helps us to understand and provides a way to interact with the outside world. Communication language consists of facial expressions, hand gestures, and tone of speech for interpreting the actions and words spoken by a person. Sign language is the only source of communication for deaf and dumb people to communicate with the outside world. But very few normal people can understand the sign language properly. Sign language changes with the change of geographical regions, language and religions. So, almost every country of the world has its own sign language. India also has its sign language which is used by the physically impaired community (Indian Sign Language (ISL)). The work discussed here is a novel approach for recognition of ISL from continuous video captured from the web camera in real life condition.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Pollution Index Estimation of Green Mobile Communication
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: The colossal increase in mobile users in today's technology leads to heavy traffic in cell communication which results in a substantial increase in mobile radiation. This mobile radiation or electromagnetic radiation shows its footprint on global warming as well as on the environment. When electromagnetic radiation exceeds beyond the threshold level it results in electromagnetic pollution measured as Electromagnetic pollution index of a cell. The electromagnetic pollution index is defined as the product of normalized polluted area and polluting energy in a cell. An existing literature shows an evidence of electromagnetic pollution index measurement considering free space model, but their derived mathematical model failed to provide accurate results. To measure the electromagnetic pollution index, this research has focused on the free space propagation model (Line of sight) using an isotropic antenna for green communication in a macro cell. The proposed methodology evaluates the electromagnetic pollution index considering simulation parameters like frequency, number of users, power and radius of macro-cell. It is observed from the results the Electromagnetic pollution index in the environment is significantly affected with high transmission power, frequency and number of users. The obtained results of the electromagnetic pollution index is hazardous i.e., beyond 150 Watt-hour and hence an optimum design for low Electromagnetic pollution index (say <; 150 Watt-Hour) in the environment has been suggested.

articleTitle: Economical Electric Rickshaw from Conventional Engine Rickshaw
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: As India strives to fulfill its vision of an all-electric vehicle industry by 2030, electric and hybrid vehicle manufacturing have become the need of the hour. In India, despite a myriad of challenges and obstacles, electric vehicles (EVs) are steadily gaining traction. The paper proposes the implementation criteria for converting an existing engine rickshaw to the futuristic electric rickshaw. The hardware requirements related to this conversion is also mentioned in the paper. For the conversion, a motor driven transmission system is incorporated into the rickshaw. As a further extension to this work, solar panels can be mounted atop the vehicle to supply power assisting or if possible replacing the battery power to the motor, hence making the vehicle into a solar powered electric vehicle.

articleTitle: A New 2-Scroll Chaos Plant with Multistability and its Circuit Realization
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: A new 2-scroll chaos plant with multistability is reported in this work. Qualitative dynamical properties of the new nonlinear plant are displayed with signal phase plots and bifurcation analysis. The new chaos dynamical plant has multistability and four saddle-type rest points, viz. a saddle rest point at the origin and three saddle-foci rest points. Also, a MultiSIM realization of the nonlinear plant with chaos oscillator with multistability is built for checking the real-world implementation of the chaos nonlinear plant with multistability.

articleTitle: Textual Entailment based on Semantic Similarity Using WordNet
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: We propose a method for automatic recognition of textual entailment based on word sense disambiguation using cosine similarity proposed by Abdalgader and Skabar. This algorithm finds semantic similarity of the sentence pairs- entailing text and entailed text. Both the hypothesis and text are converted into vectors using Jiang and Conrath similarity measure and cosine similarity is computed. Based on the cosine similarity score, a threshold is applied and the sentence pairs are classified into entailment and no entailment. The accuracy of the proposed scheme is better or comparable to many of the state of the art schemes.

articleTitle: Application of Newton iterative process in approximation of fractional differentiator and integrator
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: The band specific realization of fractional order controllers and filters find its way into implementation through the approximated value as its realization in the original form is very difficult. The integer-order passive structure of the fractional operator is built based upon its approximated integer-order transfer function. Therefore, approximation is an essential part of fractional order elements which are ideally characterized by constant phase and constant slope in the entire frequency range. The realizable approximated solutions are obtained by either finding alternate placement of real poles and zeros on the left half of s-plane, so that the slope of the approximated transfer function remains constant or by performing iterations and using continued fraction expansion. In this paper the authors have studied two techniques of approximation viz. Carlson and NPC techniques, both of which are based on Newton iterations. All the mathematical steps involved in each of the method to obtain the solution is presented in detail. A comparison of the two methods is also presented. Two fractional operators, one-fourth differentiator and nine-tenth integrator are chosen for simulation purpose. The results obtained in terms of frequency response are compared with the ideal response using MATLAB.

articleTitle: Pilot-Aided Semi-blind Channel Estimation Utilizing Intrinsic Interference for MIMO-FBMC/OQAM Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: The idea of multi-cell started form the first generation (1G) of cellular technology though it was just the analog service which uses high frequency was used to modulate the signal. With the start of the second generation (2G) cellular technology this got shifted to digital approach which includes the digital encryption of voice, thereby increasing security and also it introduced SMS. With the release of third generation (3G) cellular technology, the mobile devices started to connect with the internet and also got enhanced on security and privacy. 4G is said to be the advanced version of 3G technology. LTE has evolved with promise of increased downlink and uplink data rates. The use of OFDMA and MIMO technology provides improved performance for LTE service.Filter bank multi-carrier (FBMC) transmission utilizing offset quadrature amplitude modulation (OQAM), found to be the next promising technique after OFDM for the future wireless communication. FBMC reduces the Inter Symbol Interference (ISI) and increases the bandwidth efficiencyis increased. The MIMO channel for the filter bank multi-carrier system based on offset quadrature amplitude modulation can be estimated by utilizing the pilot signals. The essential and adequate condition for the orthogonal channel estimation can be derived by decomposing the received pilots into real and imaginary components. Using semi-blind method that is arranging a bundle of pilots, forcing scalar ambiguities to the subsequent sequences increases the performance of the channel to be estimated. Finally the performance is evaluated.

articleTitle: FPGA Implementation of FBMC Baseband Modular for 5G Wireless Communication
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: In recent years research, selection in regard to a potential waveform successor for the fifth generation (5G) telecommunication systems has been focused. On a contrary with OFDM, Filter-bank Multicarrier (FBMC) modulation has been put forward as a next valid waveform to be used in 5G systems because to its finer spectral efficiency and reduced out-of-band emissions. As an outcome, baseband processors to be developed in hardware, as the current state of the work was done, evaluating former design proposals for instance Polyphase Network and Frequency Spreading FBMC Transmitter. Based on the research, architecture to be realized was chosen. The system technologically advanced on comparison with a prevailing software model using MATLAB. The reconfiguration, concise size, high computational power makes FPGA efficient in DSP applications. The developed work involves modelling and execution of FBMC baseband modulator and evaluates key metrics concerning performance, resource utilization and power consumption on FPGA. The proposed architecture is simulated and synthesized using Verilog HDL in Xilinx ISE Design Suite 12.1 and to be implemented on Spartan -3 XC3S50 FPGA board. The recommended structure can be progressed further to surge the complexity of the hardware structure as a result of which a reduced amount of resource could be used to model prototype hardware for the presented FBMC scheme.

articleTitle: Droop Control of Proportional Resonant controller Fed Hybrid Distrubuted Generator in Low voltage AC Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Power flow control is vital in microgrids whether it is AC or DC microgrid. Many Droop control techniques are used to efficiently control the power injected by DGs (distributed generators) in a decentralized manner. Residential low rating microgrids are eventually increasing which are hybrid in nature and need to control the power injected to a grid in grid-connected and to meet power balance in Islanded modes. A modified current based power point tracking is proposed in this paper to improve transient behavior of DC side parameters thus improves DC bus voltage regulation and Proportional resonant control is introduced which is responsible to control the active and reactive power flow simultaneously from inputs given by droop controller. The same reference is used to extend the droop control strategy in a grid-connected case also with necessary modifications.

articleTitle: Circuit Detection in Web and Social Network Graphs
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Social network is a source of large scale data, and much information can be obtained by analyzing this data. Social networks and web are generally described by a directed graph. These kinds of graphs exhibit structural properties such as circuit paths, overly and connectedness. Circuits in a graph has a vital role in defining the properties of the graph and also is a challenging factor in structured searching and analysis. In this paper, we present two circuit searching algorithms to detect relevant circuits from a directed graph.

articleTitle: Autonomous Navigation of an Unmanned Ground Vehicle for Soil Pollution Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: The growth in minor port projects along India's coastline due to burgeoning investor interest and the complete freedom given by the governments to private entrepreneurs to develop and operate these ports have led to several environmental and social costs. Activities around ports such as dredging, cargo operations, discharges from ships and industries that are setup along the coastline, and construction work have had a heavy toll on the marine ecology. To exacerbate the issue, several of the minor ports are situated in highly sensitive ecological regions. Local fishing communities are most impacted by the chemicals as well as other toxic materials that are being deposited in the soil and in the marine ecosystem. We propose an autonomous robotic system to periodically collect soil samples for pollution monitoring around the coastal regions as a step towards tackling the problem. In this work, we present a ROS based navigation system for the Clearpath Husky Unmanned Ground Vehicle (UGV) to autonomously navigate on roads around coastal regions using an OSM map. Upon reaching the site to be monitored, the robot switches to a coverage algorithm for collecting soil samples from different sampling points.

articleTitle: Position Sensorless Control for BLDC Motor for Powertrain Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Electric vehicle (EV), being a solution to the increased environmental pollution and sound pollution, coming to mainstream use as a passenger vehicle. Permanent magnet motors are being used extensively in EV powertrains. Brush Less DC motor (BLDC) is one of the prime choices. BLDC gives higher power density compared to the Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor (PMSM). Rotor position sensors, usually hall sensors, are required in BLDC motors for their operation, whether it is starting or running. The problem associated with the use of a rotor position sensor is that the failure will affect the operation of the machine. Using such a vulnerable system in an EV on a fast-moving highway will result in a fatal accident. So in this paper, a position sensorless controller for BLDC motor which is controlled by Field Oriented Control (FOC) is discussed. A comparison of normal FOC and sensorless control is also presented. To showcase the effectiveness of the proposed method in EV applications, the method is tested against some well-known driving cycle scheme such as WLTC Class 3 and UDDS drive cycles.

articleTitle: A paradigm of Sixth Sense: Finger Cursor
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Sixth sense can be defined as a wearable gestural interface that augments our physical world with the digital information and also lets us communicate with this information using natural hand gestures. Without any mechanical means humans can interface with the machine (HMI) and interact with them. As we know today, human- machine interaction is very important aspect for user friendliness. Most of the gadgets today use touch screen technology, but this is too often nowadays. [3] Till now everybody is using mouse to operate computers, but surveys have found that using mouse continuously can cause various health issues like carpel tunnel syndromes, repeated motion injuries etc. Also due to the short wire the area of reach is limited. People with crippled hands or fingers are not able to use computers as they cannot hold the mouse or control a touch pad. Considering these problems we put forth the idea of “FINGER CURSOR: SIXTH SENSE TECHNOLOGY”, where you don't need to touch the screen or hold the mouse but can control the cursor by moving fingers in the atmosphere. Here we use a webcam as hardware and MATLAB as software. We implement our project using RGB (RED, GREEN, BLUE) caps. The computer interprets these caps and we can move the cursor accordingly. We capture real time videos which are converted into frames processed by extracting its RGB components, gray scale, binary and further evaluating its centroid. The mouse movements are carried out using the Robotic Class of Java. We also add features like screenshot and right click operation.

articleTitle: Automated Feature Extraction of Hepatic US Image of Dog Using Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Image processing has been one of the key factors in the area of Biomedical engineering especially in the detection of diseases. Incorporation of engineering methods in medical science has paved way for many optimistic outcomes that are much easier, cost effective and less time consumer when compared to conventional techniques. Image processing is one such technique. Here, the Ultra Sonography (US) images of the canine affected with hepatic and splenic carcinoma is the source, of which the features of cancer affected area is found out. Image preprocessing, image segmentation and feature extraction are the three stages in image processing that aids in the extraction of different features of canine inclined towards such cancers. Weiner filter is used for image denoising and Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization (CLAHE) is the method for enhancement of the US images. These two processes comprise of image preprocessing. Image segmentation is achieved using adaptive threshold method. Finally, Gray Level Co-occurrence Matrix (GLCM) is used to extract the features of the segmented area.

articleTitle: Attribute value generation using association rule mining
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: This paper presents an approach to generate attribute values of a record in a table using association rule mining. The proposed method generates a new record based on an existing record in the table. The generation of new values is subject to the constraints specified in the form of association rules. This approach can be used in automatic composition of music out of a `raaga' and in generation of dance steps in choreography. The proposed approach has been experimented to generation a new composition on Indian classical music raaga Bhupali on Sitar.

articleTitle: Arduino Based Automatic Human Seeker Robot for Disaster Management
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: The occurrence of natural calamities leading to the missing of human is a prominent barrier for effective rescue operations. The history of rescue operations in recent years has reported the lack of effective scheme for identification of people in danger. This paper deals with the development of an Arduino based rescue robot for detection of people trapped in land or water areas affected by natural calamities serving the additional purpose of transporting emergency food and medical aids to the people. The proposed system incorporates PIR sensors, Ultrasonic sensors to detect the presence of living beings. Also a Gas sensor is incorporated to detect the presence of poisonous gases in the area to aid the rescue operations. A moving mechanism equipped with a float sensor is integrated to make the robot capable of translation of its travel from land to water. A control system for movement of robot in all directions by android application is integrated into the system and a live streaming facility is included for assessing the status of the living being to be rescued. The designed system offers additional aid in the assessment of the presence and status of living bodies in an effective manner with reduced effort by using android application.

articleTitle: FPGA based speed controller for 8/6 switched reluctance motor using hysteresis controller
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: ─With the rapid enhancement in semiconductor technologies accompanied by the global push for electric vehicles, the switched reluctance motor is on the limelight for it's substantial properties such as robustness, large fault tolerance, absence of permanent magnet, low construction and maintenance cost. Now a days, FPGAs have become an alternative to processor based solutions, since it lowers the total system cost, consumes lower power and gives a flexible and scalable solution in motor control. SRM has complex control mechanism and have high torque ripple. The speed control is complicated because it's inductance varies with respect the SRM's rotor position. This paper presents a speed controller for an 8/6 SRM using hysteresis control logic by measuring the stator current and the rotor speed. The drive is simulated in SIMULINK and implemented using Xilinx FPGA.

articleTitle: Application of Multi-Stage Filtering and Multi-Layer Model in the Context of Dark and Non uniformly Illuminated Images
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: The increasing relevance of photography leads to the development of image processing techniques. Among the entire image processing steps., image enhancement is one of the most important one. Nowadays image enhancement is used for various applications like object recognition., remote sensing., surveillance., computer vision., etc. In this paper an image enhancement algorithm which enhances dark and non-uniformly illuminated images affected by bad weather conditions like rain., fog and haze are presented. This method is a combination of multi-stage filtering of rainy image and multi-layer model based image enhancement algorithms. The whole process involves three steps. They are rain streak removal., fog or haze removal and image enhancement. Experimental results show that the presented method improves the visual quality of images very well. PSNR and SSIM values are calculated and compared with existing methods.

articleTitle: Single Phase Load Balancing in a Three Phase System at Feeder and Consumer Level
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: This paper presents load balancing technique of 3 phase system at consumer load and rearrangement of the installation at unit level itself. It will help load balance between phases.Also reduction of electricity bills. Automatic balancing is based on a switching technique following certain equations & constraints. This method can be used on both feeders & unit level. In this paper load unbalancing of three phase system is implemented in MATLAB & load is balanced with respect to algorithm.

articleTitle: A Novel Slotted Patch Antenna Geometry Using Circular Split Ring Resonator
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: An improvement in the performance of a novel microstrip slotted patch antenna geometry by the use of a CSRR at the rear side of the ground is proposed. The substrate used is 60 mm × 60 mm × 1.6 mm epoxy glass that has a deictic layer of 4.4 and tanδ of 0.02. Coaxial feeding technique has been employed to excite the structure at its fundamental frequency of operation. The proposed prototype may be used for radiolocation purpose at the design frequency of 2.73 GHz and also at the sideband frequencies of 9.11 GHz and 9.32 GHz, fixed satellite at 4.47 GHz and 8.81 GHz, mobile applications except aeronautical mobile at 5.67 GHz and 7.81 GHz and for fixed mobile applications at 7.1 GHz. The final two design stages have been fabricated and an experimental verification has revealed their performance to be in close approximation to the simulated ones.

articleTitle: Autonomous Car With Swarm Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Transportation made much improvement in the human race, and it is inseparable from life. The researches based on making cars more faster and safer is on the rise still the accidents involving cars are increasing every day. Reduce the rate of accidents can be controlled by the semi-autonomous system, a machine assist that help the human drivers avoid the possible accidents taking control of the car in crucial situations. Based on this the researches based on the fully autonomous cars (AV) also began. Autonomous cars which can drive around like humans or better than humans, being the most researched area in recent years many building techniques and algorithms discussed. Swarm intelligence a natural phenomenon which helps the birds and flies to fly in optimum speed without colliding with each other. Incorporating this intelligence into autonomous cars helps in avoiding collision with neighbours and also enables cooperative driving between autonomous cars. This paper discusses a building technique of AV with swarm intelligence capabilities.

articleTitle: Application of Machine Learning and Big data Analytics in Pharmacovigilance and Drug Safety
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Machine learning technique is revolutionizing in all stages of drug discovery and developments starting from drug design, pivotal clinical trials to clinical practice. Application of machine learning techniques and big data analytics for looking upon the unintended effects of new or commonly prescribed medicines would enhance new technical approaches to generate and test `signals' related to drug safety. It would craft as a path finder for pharmacovigilance resources, time, and skills for transforming the efforts from a volume-based focus to a value-based focus. This article provides a comprehensive overview of the current scenario of pharmacovigilance programme, the importance of real world data, and machine learning analytics in the conduct of pharmacovigilance for better reproducibility and reliability. Precise and in-depth evaluation and prediction of drug safety database using machine learning techniques were also discussed in this paper. The utilization of these techniques in pharmacovigilance programme will improve its accuracy and reproducibility, and will boost this drug safety surveillance system's role as a pillar in patient safety.

articleTitle: A Comparison Study of Optimization Based PI Controller Tuning for PQ Improvement in DSTATCOM
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: A Distribution static compensator (DSTATCOM) has become a potential choice in alleviating power quality(PQ) issues in distribution network with non-linear loads. DSTATCOM essentially maintains the PCC voltage and inverter DC link voltage by using two AC and DC PI controllers. Conventionally the computation of these gain values of PI controllers are done based on the model based or trial and error method. This paper presents comparitive study of optimisation based approach for obtaining the k<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p</sub> and k<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</sub> values of the pi controller. Particle swarm optimization(PSO) and Ant colony optimization(ACO) based PI controller tuning is used in DSTATCOM for improved dynamic response and also the power quality improvement. The DSTATCOM is modeled and simulated in MATLAB/SIMULINK. The optimization techinques based PI controller tuning have been compared with conventional approach and thier performances are verified.

articleTitle: Submodule Clustering based on Latent Representation Tensor
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: This paper focuses on clustering of image dataset based on multilinear algebra. The proposed method is designed to work in two scenarios: 1. when the samples available are sufficient and 2. when the samples are limited. The proposed method is based on tensor-based approach which models clusters as a union of free submodules rather than union of subspaces. The proposed method is inspired by the self-expressiveness property which says that the image belongs to a particular submodule can be expressed as t-linear combination of data points in its own submodule whereas, it is difficult to express it as at-linear combination of data points that belongs to a different submodule. The key steps involved in the process of clustering are:- the submodule identification and grouping of images based on the identified submodule membership. Firstly, a tensor is constructed by arranging images in the dataset as the lateral slice of it for the effective utilization of structural information. In the next step, submodule identification is done on this tensor by capturing the self-expressiveness property through a representation tensor. When the datasamples are limited, the conventional method fails to cluster accurately. A latent representation tensor is incorporated into the model to maintain the clustering accuracy. Experimental results reveals that the proposed method yields better results as comnared with the state-of-art methods.

articleTitle: Image Encryption and Reversible Watermarking on Quad and Non-quad Channel Images
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: In the past few years, several security algorithms such as encryption and watermarking algorithms have been put forward in order to ensure the security of the digital image from attackers. Most of the encryption algorithm make use of relatively small key spaces and hence it provides less security to attackers.The proposed system make use of an image encryption algorithm that is working on the principle of Rubik's cube. Watermarking techniques are added to the image before applying Rubik's cube algorithm so as to provide more security for the digital image. The above algorithm is applied on both RGB images and ARGB images and a comparison evaluation is done between the two image types using various performance metrics.

articleTitle: Expert System To Diagnose and Suggest Advices for Dysgraphia
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Dysgraphia is a lack in the capacity to compose or write, essentially handwriting. Dysgraphia is a disability of transcription, implying that Dysgraphia is composition issue related with orthographic coding, handwriting which is impaired (orthography, the putting away procedure of composed words and preparation of alphabets in them), and sequencing of fingers (writing requires muscles movements). In the field of Artificial Intelligence, an Expert System is a PC framework that has capacity and ability of decision taking just like an intelligent human. Expert Systems are designed to handle difficult problems by going through collections of information, which is represented as if-else rules rather than the procedures. In this report we propose structuring an expert system for diagnosing dysgraphia.

articleTitle: A Novel Single Stage Standalone Five Level MLI Topology Scheme Having Battery as Energy Storage Element for Rural Deployment
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Multilevel inverters (MLI) have made a good vibe in industry and research areas. The classical MLI topologies are authenticated to be reasonable substitute in the vast range of medium and high power applications. In this paper, a new single phase five level MLI topology is proposed for renewable energy applications. The proposed inverter is derived from the classical cascaded H-bridge MLI topology with reduced component count. Hence, the voltage contrast and rating, cost, weight, and control complexity are curtailed. The topology is examined through simulations and authenticated with hardware implementation. A comprehensive comparison of proposed MLI is made against the classical MLI topologies.

articleTitle: Web Search Using Automatically Generated Facets
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: World Wide Web is the vital source for millions of users. The primary goal of the WWW is to provide the valid, right and the most relevant information for the end users who is searching for the information. Navigating through a number of pages for the right information is a difficult task. A novel method to ameliorate end user search experience by combining sub-queries and facets is proposed. Facets are group of words or phrase which summarize and explain the various aspects of a query. The significant information about a query usually represented in retrieved documents as list so query facets can be generated by combining these important lists. Removal of useless items from list can lead to the formation of good quality facet.

articleTitle: Automation of Visitor Gate Pass Management System
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Nowadays, Radio Frequency IDentification (RFID) cum Biometric based Access Control System (ACS) is gaining popularity for authenticating the employees of any organization, which ensures that only the employees granted permission to get into the organizational complex. However, visitors from various organization need to be granted entry into the complex, without which organization does not function effectively as all the organization invariably depend on other organization/ companies/firms for their growth. Contrary to this, most of the terrorist attacks are accessed, planned and implemented through visitors. Thus it becomes highly essential to implement highly effective method/system to ensure the genuineness of visitors to any organization. One such system, namely Visitor Gate Pass Management System[VGPMS] is illustrated with its features.

articleTitle: An Insight into Parallel Computing Paradigm
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: This millennium will observe the rising growth of parallel computing and wider use of these technologies at every level of mainstream computing. Parallel computing is becoming an essential computational tool used for saving time and cost complexity, doing several things all at once, solving complicated problems within a short span of time, making better utilization of parallel hardware and overcoming the memory constraint. This scientific area of research will progress from a niche focusing on finding solutions to scientific and engineering problems to become one of the significant computing technologies. This study provides an overview of types of parallelism, characteristics, steps, approaches of parallel algorithm, and different applications of parallel computing technologies which will be beneficial for researchers for further exploration into this emerging field of research.

articleTitle: Integer and Non-Integer Filter Design with IMC PD Controller for a First Order Delay Integrating Process
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: In this work, the control of first order delay integrating process (FODIP) is considered for study. Integrating processes are difficult to control due to the presence of a pole at origin. PD controller could be preferred in such cases for control of the processes. To improve the servo response and disturbance rejection, PD controller alone is not enough, hence Internal Model Control (IMC) structure is used for deriving PD controller parameters. The time delay in the process transfer function is an important factor to be considered when designing a controller and need a proper approximation. First order taylor series and pade approximations are considered for this work. The superiority of fractional theory in control area is also a motivation for this research work to design a non-integer controller. Hence, integer and non integer filter with IMC PD controller is derived using first order taylor series and pade approximations. Simulation study is done using Matlab/Simulink and the results show the improved performance indices of the designed controller.

articleTitle: Automated Blood Donation System using Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Machine Learning approaches has the ability to make the system to learn by itself to solve many real-world problems. In the present decade, it has changed the prospects of computing to apply every other field to work it as a transdisciplinary field. On the other side, medical applications are one of the critical areas that need to be dealt with utmost care and importance and always there are plenty of open issues that have to be addressed. Blood transfusion is a critical process as many times the survival of mankind requires this an emergency. To make this process a simple one, machine learning approaches can be utilized. In this paper, an automated blood donation system is proposed to ease the emergency situation. For choosing the best algorithm, various machine learning algorithms are considered and the best one will be chosen among that to make this system to work as perfect as possible. The final result comparison will be presented in this paper to justify the chosen algorithmic approach.

articleTitle: A Slotted Cylindrical shaped Dielectric Resonator Antenna for Multiband Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: A slotted cylindrical shaped Dielectric Resonator Antenna is discussed in this project paper. The antenna gain is varies from 4.3dBi to 6.64 dBi between the resonant frequency range of 4GHz to 13GHz.The Electromagnetic Band Gap (EBG)Structures is introduced in the ground plane to increase gain and to reduce the back lobe radiations. The cylindrical DRA is suitable for C-band, X-band and Ku-band applications.

articleTitle: A Study on Localization Techniques for Automatic License Plate Recognition System
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Automatic License Plate Recognition (ALPR) systems play a vital role in various applications such as traffic monitoring, theft detection, street monitoring, etc. Numerous techniques have been developed for license plate detection and are still in use. The challenges associated with the existing techniques are the variations in font, brightness, luminance, and geometry of the license plates and the capturing camera. This paper describes a license plate recognition system without any human intervention. The image is first pre-processed using the Successive Mean Quantisation Transform (SMQT). Then the localization of license plate is carried out in the preprocessed image. Here two techniques of localization are studied and compared. The first method uses Maximally Stable Extremal Regions (MSER) and Stroke Width Transform (SWT) algorithms to detect the text area within the image. And the second method employs Otsu - thresholding followed by morphological operations. Once the license plate region is correctly identified, segmentation and character recognition (OCR) are done to identify the license plate number.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Reaching Law Based Sliding Mode Controller and Conventional PI Controller when Implemented on a Vector Controlled Induction Motor
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Among the various ac machine drives available, induction motors have gained wide popularity due to its simple and rugged structure, excellent control capabilities, high performance four quadrant operations and high reliability. Until recently, various control approaches have been studied for performance improvement of Induction motor. Conventional PI controllers still find universally accepted solution for current regulators in industrial applications due to their dynamic performance nature. Recently sliding mode controllers have gained global acceptance due to its insensitivity to parameter variations, external disturbance rejection, robustness and fast dynamic response. The main objective of this paper is to propose a comparative study of conventional PI controller and the robust sliding mode controller applied on a vector control based induction motor drive platform.

articleTitle: A Modified High Gain Boost Converter for PV in DC Microgrid for AC and DC Application
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: This paper presents a novel boost converter for PV in a dc micro-grid for both ac and dc application. The main aim is to improve the voltage gain capacity of conventional boost converter used in PV for a DC micro-grid. Boost converters are dc to dc converter used to increase the input voltage. Conventional boost converters have low voltage gain capacity with high duty ratio. To eliminate this problem a new three level boost converter which improves the voltage gain capacity with low duty ratio is proposed. Through this modified converter the voltage gain capacity is increased. The circuit is designed in MATLAB/SIMULINK and results are verified.

articleTitle: Movie Frame Prediction Using Convolutional Long Short Term Memory
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Video frame prediction involving predicting the future frames given some input frames has been in the limelight in the recent years. However, robust models have not been developed and tested which could handle the videos involving sequence of frames having characters and objects having high temporal variations. And more significantly there are no models which embrace the sequence of frames which are extracted from movies (Example: Cartoon movies).The focus of this paper is to explore a model which could learn the spatio-temporal consistency amongst the frames which are sampled from a cartoon movie. To this end, we propose a Convolutional Long Short Term Memory based architecture wherein the model harnesses the ability of conventional Long Short Term Memory (LSTM) and convolutional neural network (CNN) to learn the time series and spatial features of the given video frame sequences.

articleTitle: Tumor Detection Using Enhanced FCM for Multimodal Brain Images
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: This paper presents Enhanced Fussy C Means (EFCM) clustering technique for detection of tumor in brain for multi modal medical images. Imaging techniques helps the physicians to visualize human body for treatment planning and diagnosis. Computed Tomography (CT) and Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) modalities are non invasive technique that assists doctors to detect the presence of suspicious regions or tumors. Uncontrolled development of tissue in any part of body is termed as tumor. Assessment of location and its dimension of tumor are essential for diagnosis of tumor. Single image such as MRI or CT may not provide maximum details about the image. For this purpose hybrid image fusion technique that integrates the Principle component analysis (PCA) and Stationary wavelet transform (SWT) is implemented. The resultant image contains complementary and redundant information from different modality imaging technique. This image is further segmented into mutually exclusive regions to extract the tumor area. In this paper, enhanced FCM clustering method is used to segment the fused image. The efficiency of this algorithm is improved by the information provided by resultant of fused image for detection of tumor. Performance of both fusion and segmentation is analyzed to obtain better quality image.

articleTitle: Image or Video Contrast Enhancement and Performace Analysis using Image Decomposition based Technique
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Due to poor lighting and atmospheric conditions, the images are often under or over-exposed which results in low contrast or quality. In this paper, an intrinsic decomposition algorithm is applied for image as well as video contrast enhancement. Intrinsic decomposition priors are used as constraints on decomposed illumination and reflectance layers to yield a better solution. It implies that neighbourhood pixels with same colour would have similar illumination and reflectance. Hence this method is designed as an optimization problem by diminishing an energy function. This decomposition model performs on HSV space in order to minimize computing complexity and avoid colour artifacts in enhanced images. Images with different lighting and atmospheric conditions are enhanced using this algorithm and quality is analysed using various image quality metrics. This method is also applied to video enhancement. Experimental results provide better enhancement results for both images and videos.

articleTitle: Dual-Pin-Fed Circularly Polarized Patch Antenna for Wi-Fi Application
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: The design of dual-pin-fed circularly polarized patch antenna is operated at the microwave frequency of 2.45GHz for Wi-Fi applications. The antenna is designed with square patch. The substrate material used is FR4 and has the relative permittivity of 4.5. It is very difficult to achieve the circular polarization with single feed. However, Dual-Pin Feed is incredibly easy to construct and achieve the circular polarization by exciting at 2 points out of section by ninety degree. The antenna has been designed and simulated by using CADFEKO software. The simulation results show that the antenna resonates at 2.45 GHz with the return loss, impedance and voltage standing wave ratio of -20.7125 dB, 49.027 + i 29.157 and 1.20295 respectively.

articleTitle: Distributed Model Predictive Control Based Formation Tracking For Differential Drive Robots
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: This paper presents a two-layer distributed Non-Linear Model predictive control (NLMPC) scheme for the formation tracking of the differential drive robots which also provides obstacle avoidance. The first layer of the control architecture is concerned about the generation of reference trajectories for the leader and the followers satisfying the formation constraints. In the second layer, a distributed NLMPC is implemented for tracking the reference trajectory from the first layer. In order to make it robust, a disturbance observer is integrated with the NLMPC.

articleTitle: Grey Wolf Algorithm Based Pid Controller for Congestion Avoidance in Tcp Network
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: In TCP networks, Active Queue Management (AQM) is used by the edge routers to network congestion and regulate the router queue length to prevent packets loss. In this study, the Grey Wolf Optimizer is deployed as a novel active queue management for optimal tuning PID controller gains to control network routers congestion, guarantee a low rate of packet loss, ensure a stable queue length, and avoid network congestion. Furthermore, the robustness of the proposed controller is analyzed and benchmarked against a classical Proportional 1-Integral (PI) controller through MATLAB simulation experiments. The results show the proposed GWO-PID controller to be stable and achieve a faster response in dynamic environments with fluctuating round trip time and network traffic.

articleTitle: PV fed High gain SEPIC-Boost converter for Vector controlled Induction Motor Drive
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: PV fed induction motor drives are gaining importance in water pumping applications in rural areas. In these applications, the use of conventional boost converter for boosting the PV output require high input filters and also they produce high input and output current ripples. As a better alternative, in this paper, the use of high gain SEPIC-boost converter for the PV fed induction motor drives is suggested, as they provide high voltage boosting with reduced input and output current ripples. For the induction motor control vector control technique is used, as it is more efficient than the conventional scalar control technique. The performance of the complete system is validated by using MATLAB simulation. The hardware prototype of the SEPIC-Boost converter fed induction motor drive is build and is tested for low voltage levels.

articleTitle: Overlapping Community Detection using Lepso and W-CPM
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Ancient community detection, it's tougher to seek out overlapping communities complicated networks, particularly once the multimedia system social networks however, actual covering group revelation with swarm intelligence oftentimes induce covering group structures with extreme tiny group. To review with the difficulty, during this paper, associate degree economical formula (LEPSO) is suggest for covering group finding that is predicated on line chart hypothesis, learning method improvement. Particularly, a separate PSO, together with associate degree cryptography theme with ordered neighbors and strategy of node change with ensemble bunch, is concocted for rising the improvement capability to go looking communities which are unseen in social networks. then, a postprocessing approach is provided for combining the finer-grained and imperfect covering communities. The contribution work is Weak Cliques Percolation Method (W-PCM) for overlapping community detection that may be a new live for distinguishing similitude between weak cliques, is additionally steered to ascertain whether or not the weak cliques can be combined into a community.

articleTitle: Improvised method of five modulus method embedded JPEG image compression with algebraic operation
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: In this paper color image is compressed using improvised five modulus method (IFFM). FMM method consists of transforming each pixel value in an 8×8 block into a multiple of 5 for each of the color elements R, G and B arrays. After that, the new values are divided by 5 and hence transformed values so obtained are 6-bits in length for each pixel and it is physically less in storage than the original value of input image which occupies 8-bits. This method enhances arithmetic calculation and embedded into JPEG format to improve the compression ratio. First RGB image converted into YCBCR then IFFM and DCT applied respectively. After that quantization of DCT coefficient being performed. Thus, quantized DCT image is become ready to perform zigzag scanning. Then the Huffman encoding and decoding has been applied. Proposed algorithm is tested on standard data set images of different classes. It exhibits much better compression ratio than the FJPEG (five modulus method embedded JPEG).

articleTitle: Real-time monitoring of Conveyor using Computer Vision and IoT
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Sorting objects in the conveyor are one of the main objectives in many manufacturing industries. This paper presents the idea to use computer vision with a low-resolution camera to sort out different objects in a conveyor based on a different colour, size, and shape and also monitor and control a conveyor in realtime by using the IoT technology. Raspberry-pi is used as the central processing unit for image processing, sorting and collecting data as well as data update by parallel processing. IoT technology is an important technology, which helps in controlling devices or collecting data regardless of distance. MQTT, a lightweight IoT protocol, is used to gather data through the internet and a GUI is made to control the conveyor through the internet as well as for real-time data visualization.

articleTitle: Non-Isolated High Gain DC-DC Converter for PV Applications with Closed Loop Control
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Nowadays DC micro grids are becoming more common in rural and urban areas.The use of photo-voltaic cells made this possible.But the output of solar PV is very low,hence converters with maximum efficiency and high gain is needed.But conventional DC-DC boost converters are unable to provide high step up voltage gain.And also the converters with voltage multiplier cells are in use but, which makes the circuit complex. Here,a closed loop control with MPPT strategy is proposed for a non-isolated high gain DC-DC converter for renewable energy source with solar energy as the input. Soft-Switching is achieved by ZVS topology.Maximum power is tracked using MPPT algorithm. The high gain converter for 20W, 17/170 V simulation circuit is designed and the performance is validated using MATLAB SIMULINK.

articleTitle: Synchrophasor Assisted Real Time Angular Stability Awareness Program for Emerging Smart Power Grids
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Real time monitoring of power system angular stability condition is essential to prevent contingencies like blackouts. In this context, this paper proposes a power grid stability awareness system powered with wide area synchrophasor system. A stability impact index based on center of inertia referenced energy of individual bus voltage angle is developed for assessing real time stability of the system. Along with that, an algorithm for identifying coherent group of generators based on a hybrid index which represents both bus angle and topological information of the system is also presented. Coherent group identification helps the operator to take necessary course of action based on system status. The proposed approach for stability assessment and coherent generator identification were validated using case studies conducted on IEEE 39 bus test system.

articleTitle: Power Factor Monitoring and Improvement using Raspberry Pi
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Improvement of power factor in an electrical system leads to reduced voltage drop, power losses and electricity bill. Capacitor banks act as reactive power generators for inductive loads thereby maintaining the power factor within the limits. The objective of this work is to monitor the power factor regularly and switch the capacitor banks accordingly to improve it. Here, voltage and current signals are given as input to Raspberry Pi, which is used to measure the power factor angle and control the power factor of the system. This controller can also be used for remote control of power factor in industries, substations and residential places.

articleTitle: Fuzzy & PI Controller Based Energy Management Strategy of Battery/ Ultracapacitor For Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Electric vehicles have gained more attraction throughout the world due to its advantage of green technology and decreased emission.. Moreover, they are being powered by battery would be the best option of replacing current petrol or gas dependent vehicles. There are some drawbacks associated with battery; it has limited lifetime and cost is very high. Hence, it is hybridized with other energy storage systems such as Ultracapacitor/Supercapacitor. This work uses a fuzzy and PI control for Energy management system for Electric Vehicle and Simulation environment chosen is Matlab/Simulink.

articleTitle: Power Quality with ANN and Hysteresis controllers
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: The advantages of converting and controlling the huge electrical power by power electronic converter, lead the entire world to use them enormously. As the nonlinear nature semiconductor devices which are used in power electronic converters has the generation of harmonics to distort the Supply current. In controlling application, the firing angle is applied for switching on of Power Electronic devices leading to a phase difference between voltage and current. This phenomenon draws the reactive power from the Supply. To wipe out these two problems, Shunt Active Power Filters are designed. In this paper, modeling and design of APF parameters are discussed. The two controller viz. voltage controller and current controller are used. PI and advanced ANN are utilized for voltage controller. The hysteresis controller is utilized as current controller to provide proper switching pattern to MOSTETs of APF. The detailed simulation study of the system, results and the discussions for balanced and unbalanced loads have been have been presented. The comparison between the PI and ANN used as voltage controller for various firing angle has been reported. This work is validated by the hardware implementation using dSPACE 1004 for developing the switching pattern by joining the MATLAB Simulation and Hardware Set Up.

articleTitle: Safe Overtaking System using Raspberry Pi
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: A lot of accidents are happening while people are attempting to overtake heavy vehicles on the road. Due to their large size, majority of the visibility of the road is lost for the drivers following behind the heavy vehicles. So driver has no idea about what's happening in front of the heavy vehicle. A wrong decision can even results potential death of the passengers and drivers of the light vehicles. This paper introduces a technology to stream video wirelessly from a camera, which is mounted on the front of the heavy vehicle to the vehicle following behind the heavy vehicle. The heavy vehicle is equipped with a camera, Raspberry PI and a QR code. The light vehicle is equipped with a Camera, Raspberry PI 3 B and display. The heavy vehicle captures the image and streamed to the light vehicles through a secured hotspot. The credentials of the Wi-Fi hotspot is encoded in a QR code. The light vehicle will scan this QR code in order to establish a connection. Once a connection is established, the heavy vehicle will start to send the visuals from the camera to the connected vehicle, the connected vehicle will stream the video.

articleTitle: Diagnosis and Classification of Epileptic Seizure a Neurological Disorder Using Electroencephalography
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: An epileptic seizure is a neurological disorder which is result of sudden excessive electrical discharge from neurons which may cause loss of consciousness. The brain signals can be measured by using Electroencephalography (EEG). In this paper we analyze the EEG signal in time frequency domain and classify the signal as seizure and non-seizure. The available standard online database is used which is acquired by International standard 10-20 EEG placement system. The signal is then preprocessed to remove power noise and eye blink artifact. The features such as mean, standard deviation, variance, skewness and kurtosis are found, which are classified by classifier such as Support Vector Machine, K-Nearest Neighbor algorithm and Probabilistic Neural Network. The performances of above classifier are evaluated on the bases of sensitivity, specificity and accuracy.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Various Spatial Filters on Noisy Images - A Quantitative Approach
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Choosing a suitable denoising filter acts a significant role in the image restoration procedure. Smoothing or reduction of noise present in the image is a significant preprocessing task before segmenting and analyzing the features present in an image. This paper is focused on choosing a desired filter for performing denoising process through some of the well-known image quantitative metrics. Some of the traditional filters are taken for experimentation and quantitative results are compared. In order to evaluate the degree of smoothness of the resultant images, quantitative metrics such as MSSIM (Mean Structural Similarity Index), PSNR (Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio), and MSE (Mean Square Error) are used. This paper gives guidance in selecting an appropriate filter for performing denoising process through quantitative metrics.

articleTitle: An Unveiling Navigation in Fog Ambiance by FPGA based Autonomous Vehicle with Minimal Sensing
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: This paper provides an approach for reference-less object detection for outdoor environment adaptable for navigating an autonomous vehicle. The computational efficiency of the image processing is to be questioned on its throughput in practical environment; a minimal sensing approach is needed to fulfil the gap formed due to this, so we propose a heuristic approach for tracking an object in dense fog ambiance. Driving through an environment with partial visibility may be fatal; a solution to this problem relies in prior intimation of object to be confronted based on the echo signal obtained. Depending on the nature of the obstacle, it can be dodged accordingly. As soon as the obstacle is detected the array of sensors gives the basic information of the obstacle. The Proposed algorithm is capable enough of finding the distance between the objects and analysing them through control unit designed by FPGA thereby confirming their nature of being static or dynamic. Efficiently making the robot to traverse through this adverse environment. This can be extended/applied to the field of automotive.

articleTitle: Energy Efficient Solutions for IoT Based Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: With the advent of Internet of Thing (IoT) smart living is no longer a day dream. It advantages people by saving time, cost as well as energy. Energy is the most important facet of IoT. The feature of remote monitoring and controlling applications in real time plays a huge role in saving energy. Energy efficient applications are the assets of IoT. It has become ubiquitous due to its energy efficiency. Its omnipresence results in billions of IoT devices which are able to connect with each other and share information to and fro. However, communication among these devices needs some energy for sensing, transmitting and storing information. IoT applications which are implemented on larger level consumes massive amount of energy which is scarce in nature. Thus, its own energy efficiency is an area of concern and a vital area of research. This paper addresses those common aspects of IoT which usually led to high energy consumption. A survey is done to represent the previous works done in this direction. Also, solutions are suggested to reduce energy consumption in IoT based applications.

articleTitle: An Efficient Palette Reordering For Lossless Compression of Color Indexed Images
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Image compression with color image re-indexing is a key focus in this research. Improving the efficiency of the current state-of-art approach which is TSP based Ant colony optimization by increasing the compression gain is a prime focus. However, obtaining an optimal re-ordering for a palette is a crucial task to choose from by any brute-force way. We have successfully outperformed the existing method using PNG as codec and applying a circular shift as our heuristic method.

articleTitle: Solar PV grid connected system using Phase Lock Loop Synchronization and SPWM technique
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: In this paper a phase lock loop-based grid-tied solar inverter is designed and verified in MATLAB. Here PLL has been utilized so as to synchronize the yield voltage of inverter with framework voltage [3]. Thus, to achieve the same a sinusoidal reference is generated from PLL Output which generates PWM signal which is controlled by grid voltage [7]. This paper proposes a simulation model of the Solar PV grid connected system (closed loop) using sinusoidal pulse width modulation and Phase lock loop for grid synchronization. The proposed scheme is verified in MATLAB.

articleTitle: Signal Demodulation without Channel Equalizer Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: With the unprecedented availability of computing and data resources, there has been a widespread trend in using machine learning techniques in the field of communication as well. In the existing communication system, signal demodulation in multipath channel works with the aid of equalizers to mitigate the effect of inter-code cross talk and inter-symbol interference. Owing to the ability other machine learning models to learn the complex structure in feature space, deep learning architectures such as Deep Belief Network(DBN) and Stacked Auto Encoders(SAE) are used for demodulation in this paper. The experiments were conducted in a multipath Rayleigh channel. Simulation results shows the feasibility and hegemony of the deep learning model over the conventional demodulation techniques using equalization.

articleTitle: Wearable Exoskeleton Assisted Rehabilitation in Multiple Sclerosis by Using an Intelligent Control Method
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: A walking model with humanoid robot RH-2 can perform distinctive assignments in a joint control by using various controller methodologies are presented in this paper. The human-robot coordinated control has a regular framework for the human-robot association. In human-robot, we are using the linear and nonlinear control systems to control the single inverted pendulum. In humanoid stride is frequently displayed with different forms of the modified pendulum, for example, 2D and 3D linear reversed pendulums. A human-robot is using the direct control system for using trial and error method using with PID controller and neural network based PID controller under different working conditions. Intelligent control systems have many advantages over basic controllers. They provide a high adaption to changing conditions and have the ability to make decisions quickly by processing imprecise information. Also, they can perform perfectly even with non-linearity. In this work, the artificial neural network (ANN) technique will be utilized for control of the robot leg model.

Author Keywords: Linear and nonlinear control functions and Walking control with different conditions

articleTitle: Convex Decomposition Model for Salient Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: An efficient background-salient object separation using background priors is proposed in this paper. When the image is cluttered, it is difficult to decompose the image into foreground and background regions. In order to overcome this limitation, feature vectors are computed from the image using Simple Linear Iterative Clustering algorithm (SLIC). In the next step feature matrix is decomposed into low-rank and sparse component using a convex model. The separation between background and salient object is increased by incorporating background priors into the model. The background priors chosen are location, color and boundary connectivity. In contrast with the bench mark methods, the proposed method delivers accurate result at a faster rate.

articleTitle: Comparison of Maximum Power Point Tracking techniques used for solar photovoltaic system
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: The renewable sources of energy have become a good alternative for conventional sources of energy resources. Hence, the utilization of renewable energy resources like solar, wind etc. has increased the need of research for improving the efficiency of such renewable energy resources so that the maximum energy can be extracted from such renewable sources. This paper presents a comparison between the two Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) algorithms used for the solar renewable system, namely Perturb and Observe (P&O) method and Incremental Conductance (IC) method. Limitation of P&O method and advantages of IC method is discussed in this paper. This comparison study will be helpful for future solar photovoltaic (P-V) applications.

articleTitle: Design of Wideband Monopole Antenna for Automotive Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: In this paper, a Bell house shape antenna is proposed for automotive antenna cover frequency ranges from (1-12)GHz. A bell house shaped structure shaped is proposed with monopole antenna, which is used to print at the roof top of the car. The proposed antenna reflection coefficients are -11dB at 2.3GHz, -23dBat 4.7GHz, -39dB at 6.4GHz and 28dB at 10.7GHz. The results of these antennas are represented in terms of reflection coefficient, VSWR, radiation pattern. A bell house shape antenna is used for various application.

articleTitle: Clutch Accelerator Training and Helping Machine: IOT Based driving teaching and assistance system
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: This training and helping machine which not only helps you to learn a car but also lets anyone drive a manual transmission car like an automatic transmission. It releases clutch pedals and presses accelerator pedal accordingly as per traffic environment, irrespective of how fast you are releasing machine clutch pedal. This machine is especially for people who lack driving skills. Rather than making car fully automatic or self-driven, this machine will ensure that the controlling body is still you and machine is only an assistant i.e. - self auto-correcting part of the car ONLY. Although the machine is in contact with car pedals, still full control will lie with you. Although semi-automatic transmission is available nowadays, training feature plus choosing skill levels through IOT app which uses firebase realtime database and the machine will self-adjust according to the user skills. Ensuring how much control is in your hand and how much machine has to handle.

articleTitle: Automated Detection of Microaneurysm using Textural Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Diabetic retinopathy (DR), a common medical condition in diabetes patients, is a major cause of blindness. DR affects those who have diabetes for 20 years or more. By proper monitoring, major cases of DR could be rectified. The longer a person has diabetes, the higher his or her chances of developing diabetic retinopathy. Each year, DR accounts for 12% of all new cases of blindness. The algorithm proposed in this paper focuses on detection of DR using cross sectional and local binary pattern (LBP) features. Proposed system was tested on a database of 150 fundus images with mild to moderate signs of microaneurysms (MAs). Healthy and DR images were distinguished using three popular classifiers, among artificial neural network (ANN) shows highest accuracy of 92% and sensitivity of 100%.

articleTitle: Power Monitoring System in Solar Power Plant Using LabVIEW
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Solar energy entrenched the foremost exuberant renewable energy resources obtainable and in most regions of the plant its theoretical potential is much in far more than present total primary energy provide in those regions. The work knowledge of information watching is very helpful therefore its decreasing the manual work and therefore the errors in data. associate degree investment in an exceedingly facility infrastructure are often a troublesome prospect for any plant engineer. The modularity of the system makes the development of dispatch centers easier, beginning with the fore most visual of measured values and ending with distributed integrated systems designed for giant energy power grids and their power sources. Special stress is placed on high dependability the quick creation of application and straightforward setup which might be done even by less old users. Because of the innovative resolution the system will discover and report all technical and physical breakdowns occurring within the power house.

articleTitle: Neutral Current Compensation Using Three-Leg Inverter Based DSTATCOM Topologies
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
