abstract: The increased use of single-phase unbalanced and non-linear loads in a three-phase four-wire (3P-4W) distribution system has results excess current through the neutral in addition to other current related power quality (PQ) issues. Many suitable distribution static compensators (DSTATCOM) topologies have been discussed in the literature to mitigate the neutral current and other PQ problems in the distribution system. This paper introduce a comprehensive comparison study of various three-leg VSI based DSTATCOM topologies. Special focus have been given to newly developed topologies like three-leg VSI with series capacitor, three leg VSI with single DC capacitor etc. Detailed simulated performance of the various topologies are compared and presented. These studies have been carried out using MATLAB\ SIMULINK.

articleTitle: Pro-Safe: An IoT based Smart Application for Emergency Help
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: There can be any sudden situation of panic. It could be because of an intruder entering our house, an accident situation, bad health status or an assault at which we are unable to intimate to the people around us. In this paper, we proposes an implementation of emergency handling system, which is based on fall detection. The proposed system consist of an android based smart device embedded with real time fall detection.The main objective of this project is to build an automated emergency handling device with an auto triggered emergency button. Once the application is triggered it will initiate live recording of images and audio of the situation.The encrypted copy of this will be uploaded in a cloud storage which is accessible by an authentic police official. This application will also give an alert to the nearest police station with the users current location.In this paper, we compare three machine learning algorithms, Decision Tree(DT) algorithm, K-Nearest Neighbour(KNN) algorithm and Support Vector Machine(SVM) algorithm using Sis Fall dataset for training and validation so as to provide high efficiency in fall detection.In this scenario, SVM algorithm gives better accuracy and less false positive rate.Here we used triaxial accelerometer and gyroscope to collect the data. The proposed device achieves high performance by using Machine learning techniques to detect harmful fall of the person and to auto initiate by itself.

articleTitle: Invocation Based Disposition of Virtual Honeypots
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Honeypots are deployed in the network to work as the target of intruders who wish to exploit a network. Undetected honeypot serves no purpose as production systems would get compromised and honeypots result in dead investment. Previous system worked on creating a single virtual honeypot but that can be easily exploited and compromised by the adversary[3]. Proposed system would bring up virtual honeypots in the network on detection of intrusion, redirecting every exploitation request to a different virtual honeypot and collaborative log records generated by the system would be analyzed to build up strategies to reform the network can be created.

articleTitle: Parallel Approach for Document Representation using Dictionary Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: There has been drastic advancements in data science both in terms of algorithm development and storage is concerned. This work takes into consideration an area which is coming of use in data handling based on sparse representation. The collection of documents which is considered as a dictionary is large with a massive amount of data providing in. So in order to represent an incoming document in sparse mode, we have considered parallelizing the algorithm for dictionary learning and sparse code generation. This work show good improvement in reducing the time for generating sparse representation with help of GPUs. There is a 2x increase in time when compared to CPU usage for generating the same sparse code for an input collection.

articleTitle: A Survey on Energy Efficient Image Transmission in WSN
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Remote sensor networks are one of the vital advancements which are utilized in different applications in clinic, military etc. These applications utilize the different attributes of vitality reaping, versatility, adaptability while transmitting the data in the system. Despite the fact that the WSN having the effective qualities, it has a portion of issues like system stack directing, control utilization, hub disappointment and so on. In this manner, the paper presents the MIMO idea with organizing inclusion and vitality productive detecting model to keep away from the above issues. At first, the system delicate locale is broke down utilizing the Shadow blurring detection model. From the perceived district, the bunches are shaped by the idea of multiscale fluffy grouping process. Then the data is transmitted with the assistance of the lifetime amplifying dynamic vitality proficient steering convention which diminishes the control utilization process at the whole hub lifetime. The productivity of the framework is investigated with the assistance of the trial results and exchanges.

articleTitle: Intelligent APFC Relay With Real Time Monitoring, Protection & Control Capability
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Shunt Capacitor Bank (SCB) is usually preferred by power system design engineers for reactive power supports to run entire electrical network. SCB provides more flat distributed voltage profile, improves power factor of the system, reduces upstream current and hence line losses. Many times it can be configured as a “Harmonics Reduction Filter”. Hence there is need to provide protections to this `Heart of power system' for keeping it present whenever you `Need it'. The proposed scheme provides unprecedented technic of capacitor switching differently from sequentially & time dependent In/Out of SCB to achieve target Power Factor as close as possible. The proposed system also provides relay based protection scheme for protection of over/under current, over/under voltage, current unbalancing with detecting number of elements failure & involved phase. The outage time management is done by remotely monitoring & controlling facility.

Author Keywords: Detection of number of elements failure

articleTitle: FCM and Otsu ‘s Thresholding based Glaucoma Detection and its Analysis using Fundus Images
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Glaucomais a group of eye diseases that can cause permanent blindness if it is undetected or detected in a later stage. The early stage detection of glaucoma can reduce the rate of vision loss. The size of optic disc and optic cup is used to detect the presence of glaucoma. So the segmentation of optic disc and optic cup is the main step in glaucoma detection. Here, Fuzzy C Mean Clustering(FCM) and Otsu's thresholding based methods are adopted for segmenting both optic disc and optic cup. Cup to Disc Ratio(CDR) is calculated from this segmented optic disc and optic cup. The fundus image with CDR ratio greater than 0.3 is considered as glaucoma affected. CDR value less than 0.3 is considered as healthy. Based on CDR value, classification is carried out in Support Vector Machine (SVM) and DA (Discriminant analysis) classifier. The performance of these methods are evaluated using various parameters such as efficiency,specificity and sensitivity.

articleTitle: A Button shaped Dielectric Resonator Antenna for C-band and X-band Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: A Button shaped Dielectric Resonator Antenna is presented in this paper. This paper contains the parametric results of scattering parameter, Gain, Directivity, VSWR and radiation patterns characteristics. The gain and Directivity achieved is 6.83dB, 7.35 dB respectively. The proposed antenna design is resonant at the frequencies of 5.8GHz (C-band),7.2GHz(C-band) and 9.2GHz(X-band).

articleTitle: A Pent Band Resonant Microstrip Wall Hanging Shaped Patch with Slot Antenna
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: The design of a pent band resonant microstrip wall hanging shaped patch antenna using novel slotting techniques is proposed. The substrate used is FR4 epoxy that has a height of 1.6 mm above the ground and the feeding technique employed is coaxial feed. All the design stages have been analyzed over HFSS v-15 for the major parameters including the reflection coefficient, bandwidthand VSWR. The final stage design has been fabricated and experimentally verified over VNA for its reflection coefficient, bandwidth and VSWR and in anechoic chamber for its radiation pattern.The results for the simulated design of the final stage and its fabricated counterpart are in close agreement. A tabulated comparison of results of different design stages and the fabricated prototype has been included at the end of the results section.

articleTitle: Monocular Visual Odometry Approach for Trajectory Estimation of a Moving Object Using Ground Plane Geometry
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Trajectory estimation of a moving object using monocular visual odometry approach is an important research direction in computer vision. The moving object can be a car or a robot or anything which is carrying camera need to be tracked for autonomous navigation. Scale estimation of the translational motion is tedious in monocular visual odometry system. This paper proposes a new trajectory estimation algorithm in which Nister's 5-point algorithm is used as the baseline algorithm. We have adapted the method discussed in [1] for the scale estimation of trajectory with the additional input of camera height. Estimated scale is nothing but the ratio between the known camera height and the estimated camera height. The camera height shall be found by decomposing the Homography matrix. The proposed algorithm is tested with KITTI standard benchmark dataset [2]. Experimental results on KITTI dataset shows significant improvement in the trajectory estimation of moving object.

articleTitle: Design of radome FSS antenna for K and Ka-band applications
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: The rectangular spilt ring resonator (RSRR) loaded swasthik shaped frequency selective surface antenna for radome applications are presented. Then, the designed radome Frequency Selective Surface (FSS) antenna to cover the frequency of 18-40 GHz by using K- and Ka-bands. This can be simulated using CST Microwave studio and the reflection coefficient for K-band is -21.75 dB at 19GHz, Ka-band is - 15.69dB at 35.8 GHz.

articleTitle: Advancements in Origami Inspired Robots, a Review
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Robots are devices that are designed to carry out a particular set of works more effectively in a restricted environment. These systems comprise of rigid links and complex mechanisms that are compatible with the human workspace, but they also confine the robot to carry out a complex kinesis at a micro level. The limitations of the hardware have curbed the increasing capabilities of robots. origami is one of the most emerging technologies, which serves as a key to the mere future robots. The contemporary work confers the advancements taking place in the field of soft origami-inspired microrobots. Various types of actuators that can be incorporated within this system to execute complex motions is also stated in the present work. A comparative assessment is done between conventional robots and origami robots based on their design features. These new class of micro-robots will influence the humans in mitigation, environmental monitoring and Interplanetary exploration.

articleTitle: User Association Enabled Access Point Grouping in Het Nets
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: The multiple access technique used in cellular generations was OMA (Orthogonal Multiple Access), which uses different frequency for different users. They do not enjoy perfect connection in good or bad conditions. The introduction of NOMA (Non - Orthogonal Multiple Access) in 5G acts as a superior access method to OMA on various aspects, since it supports multiple users with the same frequency. Hence, spectral efficiency and throughput can be improved. In order to mitigate inter - cell interference, NOMA is implemented in ultra dense networks. The densification of network improves the co - operation among different access points for serving a single user, since the limited resources may degrade the network performance. The system efficiency can be improved to a great extent by grouping access points, since the user specific access framework provides access service. The densification of small cells and the non-orthogonality in resource sharing cause interference, user association is used to control the number of users assigned to each cell and it can control interference and to manage mobility.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Asymmetric Bellow Flexible Pneumatic Actuator (ABFPA)
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Two major factors affect the properties exhibited by a Soft Pneumatic Actuator (SPA): material and design. Corrugations are grooves or ridges that enhance the flexibility of the actuator and a variation in the shape and size of the corrugation varies the deflection exhibited by the actuator thus necessitating a study on the same to determine the parameters for design to optimize deflection. This paper designs and analyses of asymmetric bellow flexible pneumatic actuators (ABFPA) and the relationship between corrugation and corresponding deflection. Four shapes viz. square, semi-circle, trapezoid and triangle are preferred, and the optimum model and the results and manufacturing process are discussed.

articleTitle: Improved System Of Constant Power Generation In Grid Connected PV Cell With Battery
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: In this paper, grid-connected PV cell with a battery backup system is proposed. The proposed system is combination of grid connected PV system battery backup system. In day time the irradiance is high, due to this generation of power is more. But in the night time irradiance is reduced, so power generation also reduces. To overcome this drawback a battery backup system is integrated with the conventional grid connected PV system. This increases exporting rate of the power units. PV array system is sectioned into three parts such as a grid tie inverter, a grid filter, battery backup system. This system gives simple, reliable, steady and appropriate model which helps to ease the understanding of grid-connected PV system. This paper elaborates MATLAB/Simulink model of grid-connected PV panel and Battery storage systems.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Different Compensation Schemes and Inverter Topologies for CSI based Bidirectional IWPT System
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Electric Vehicles (EVs) are more challenging for future transportation in terms of higher energy efficiency and reduced carbon emission. Current Source Inverter (CSI) fed Inductive Wireless Power Transfer (IWPT) schemes has drawn considerable interest in EV battery charging for medium power applications. Bidirectional power transfer guarantees both grid to vehicle (G2V) and vehicle to grid (V2G) operations. Optimal design of associated power electronics circuitry is vital for efficient power exchange. In this paper, a detailed performance analysis is done for various combinations of inverter topologies (half-bridge and full-bridge) and compensation networks (LC and C-LC) with an aim to improve the power transfer efficiency. This paper also focuses on harmonic analysis and loss estimation in each configuration. The analysis is carried out through simulation in MATLAB/SIMULINK. Full-bridge inverter with C-LC compensation gives better performance in terms of harmonic reduction, ripple content and reduced voltage and current stress across the inverter switches.

articleTitle: Comparative Study on Different Techniques for Fencing and Monitoring Moisture Content of Soil
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: An automated irrigation system is developed to optimize the usage of water for agriculture crops. The automated system saves up to 90% compared to traditional irrigation practices. Because of its autonomous energy and low cost, the system has the potential to use water efficiently. In this paper, we are reviewing different techniques used for fencing and monitoring moisture content of the soil in agriculture fields. This paper stresses on the need for a cloud-based platform to manage database and android application. The data is sent to the microcontroller and is given to the server. The processed data would be stored in a database, further allowing the data to be interpreted simply and flexibly. A small compact autonomous system is developed and makes use of solar power. With the help of a wireless sensor, the data is collected and stored in a database for further consultation and analysis. The proposed system is capable of recognizing any unauthorized entry and provides realtime surveillance. The user will be alerted by sending an SMS to the mobile phone via GSM communication if anything goes wrong.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Algorithm for Respiration Analysis with Blind Source Seperation
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Recent researches have shown that respiratory problems are increasing day by day. These respiratory disorders mainly affect aged people mostly during sleep. Various existing systems available are expensive and have many drawbacks such as they cannot be monitored in real time and they are non-continuous methods having contact with the user. They also depend on motion artifacts. To overcome these and to promote assistive living for elders a real time contactless respiration monitoring system is designed which uses a simple and easy way of monitoring using a pair of microphones. The microphone detects the exhaled airflow and analyzes the patient's condition. The method here used is Blind Source Separation which differentiates the respiratory signals using ICA algorithm. It also analyses the real time respiratory rate of the patient. Further disease classification is done using machine learning algorithm Naïve Bayes classifier. This system successfully tested in different environment. This system helps in easy diagnosis and early care of people and reduces life threatening situations.

articleTitle: PV Powered Rubber Sheet Dryer
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: The conventional scheme of rubber sheet drying possesses the disadvantage of exposing the samples to direct sunlight for more than 7 days and further exposure to heat produced by fuel combustion in a smoke house for more than 5-8 days continuously for complete drying [1]. This process is time consuming and demands the expenditure of excess man-power and physical endeavor. This scheme also lacks appropriateness in application at monsoon season due to unavailability of direct sunlight. The conventional scheme possesses the disadvantage of the occurrence of pollution, deforestation and various health hazards to the worker. In addition, the economic losses due to the consumption of fuel such as wood leads to economic losses. Also the lack of standard temperature required for the drying of rubber is another barrier in the application of this method. This paper presents the development of an alternative to replace the existing smoke house. The method incorporates the circulation of air at constant temperature and a mechanism to maintain the temperature inside a closed structure for drying the rubber sheets. The proposed system is integrated with renewable energy sources to be used as a power source for heating. The developed system offers the convenience in maintaining a uniform temperature for drying the rubber sheets. A temperature sensor integrated with the system aids in monitoring the temperature inside the chamber in a continuous manner.

articleTitle: Novel Dynamic Voltage Restorer with Multi-Functional Capability
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Maintaining good Power Quality and un- interrupted power are extremely important goals at many type of facilities at the present scenario. As the power demand goes on increasing, Renewable energy integration becomes a vital part in power system. REI also results in many PQ issues. Hence it becomes necessary to recognize and compensate all types of disturbances at an earliest time to ensure normal and efficient operation of the power system. Among the various custom power devices used for PQ improvement, Dynamic Voltage Restorer is the most efficient and effective device that can be used to mitigate the PQ issues viewing their economic as well as implementation side. The control part of DVR has to be varied according to the nature of the load causing the Power Quality disturbance. Here a novel DVR with Multifunctional capabilities, which can solve the major Power Quality issues, is presented. The performance of the device is analyzed under different conditions such as like voltage swell, sag and harmonics as well as an outage. The operation of the improved DVR will be more efficient and accurate and energy saving when compared to other conventional DVRs. Simulation is performed in MATLAB/Simulink platform.

articleTitle: MRAS based speed sensorless vector control of Induction Motor using Sliding mode Observer
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: This paper presents the speed estimation of vector controlled speed sensorless Induction motor (I.M.) using Model Reference Adaptive System (MRAS) and Sliding mode observer. At very low speed the dynamic and steady state performance of I.M. is not adequate due to mismatch of parameters of machine. The low speed performance of induction motor is improved by using MRAS and sliding mode observer. In the reference model of MRAS the sliding mode observer is placed and current model of Induction motor is used as adjustable model. The output of the reference model and adaptive model is compared and is given to adaption mechanism and it estimates the speed of vector control induction motor. The rotor flux MRAS is used to estimate the rotor speed of induction motor and is used as feedback signals for the vector controlled Induction motor.

articleTitle: High Performance Clock Path elements for Clock Skew reduction
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: this paper is presenting the findings of project work that involves finding more efficient and faster circuit logics to bring down the clock skew. Clock skew is the instantaneous difference between the readings of two clocks arrival time. Clocks are used to drive many individual units in a circuit i.e. they are required at many points throughout the circuit at the same time. The problems pertaining to transportation of clock signals are that a fraction of current reaches millions of transistors (because of fan-out) and the clock reaches far away units at a delayed time. Both these problems can be rectified by using efficient clock inverter and clock buffer circuits. Clock skew can be reduced by either increasing delay in the faster clock path to match the slower path or by reducing the delay in the slower path by improving driving strength. To match the arrival times, tunable clock buffers and clock inverters will be designed. This paper presents speed efficient circuits for clock buffers and clock inverters which can be implemented in the pre (clock tree synthesis stage) CTS. Pre and post layout analysis are done and results are obtained using cadence tools considering sample NOC router architecture. Clock buffer designed using gpdk 045 node and compared with the proposed clock buffer of 45 nm node. The timing slack of the designed standard cells improves by 45.9% and power consumption decreases by 2.09%.

articleTitle: Deliberation of Robotic Services to Human kind using FPGA based Robot
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Navigation of Autonomous service robot is one of the challenging and emerging in the field of Human Assistive Machines with the advancement in technology. This paper deals with human robot interaction by making use of Bluetooth communication protocol to fulfill the required service as well as self-navigation mechanism. In the process of communication, Bluetooth application runs in mobile device used at human end and processed at machine end that uses FPGA for execution mechanism that interfaced with the Bluetooth module. The paired and assigned robot traversed to desired destination based on control information received from an android application developed using MIT App inventor tool in mobile phone at human end. The Bluetooth communication module interfaced with Field Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGA) from Artix-& Family, Nexys 4 xc7a100tcsg324-1 for robot control. On the platform of Verilog, developed robot control instructions during communication as well as navigation. It is simulated and synthesized using Xilinx Vivado 2017.4 and validated with FPGA based robot.

articleTitle: Securing Designs of an Area Efficient BIST Technique in UART
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Proliferation drift of IC trade, many microchips are modeled in foundry. Presence of behaving-inbuilt hardware Trojans (HTs) is of very tight security concern, without the awareness of end users or original designers of host, to identify Trojans-free circuit. For this designer seeks low switching probability nets to insert HTs to reduce power leakage. But circuit's net experiences distinct state and switching probabilities on test and function mode. Proposed method, fast heuristic, is actuated on circuit under test (CUT). This is minimal complex, high accurate, popular standard and complex circuit tested with reasonable delay. In hardware self-testing, (built in self test) offer worthy solution to reduces product failure, complexity occurs in proliferation. Design and actuation of universal asynchronous receiver transmitter (UART), to reduce power, area, to reach portable, stable and reliable data transmission is employed.

Author Keywords: universal asynchronous receiver transmitter (UART) built-in-self- test (BIST)

articleTitle: An Image Texture based approach in understanding and classifying Baby Sign Language
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: A sign language is a mode of communication in which the intent of the message or the message itself is conveyed through body postures or the movement of the parts of the body like head, eyebrows and cheeks etc. Every expression is distinct and has distinguishable parts of language, its grammatical content fully displayed through gestures. There are more than three hundred sign languages used in the world. The baby sign language is a method of communication between the mothers and their toddlers by means of gestures, clearly expressing their emotions and desires. In the present research work study of the existing literature has been carried out and then prepared a data set of still jpeg images for 60 odd baby signs, performed GLCM(Gray Level Co-Occurrence Matrix) based feature extraction, then performed classification of gestures using KNN and Random Forest based machine learning algorithms. A classification accuracy of 73% has been achieved on the dataset prepared.

articleTitle: Signal Detection Scheme Based on Deep Learning in OFDM systems
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: The quality of any communication system relies on efficient signal estimation with minimum computational and economic payoffs. Usually, the characteristics of the multipath channel used for transmission decreases the efficiency of the system. Traditionally, channel estimation is done to alleviate the effects of the channel which in turn needs a great deal of computation and bandwidth. In this paper, Deep Neural Network (DNN) is used for estimating the signal thus avoiding the extra effort of estimating the channel. The calamitous effect of Rayleigh channel in BPSK modulated OFDM systems are being extricated by the DNN and its effects are compared between different multipaths. Also, in OFDM, Cyclic Prefix(CP) is used to improve BER. Using the proposed method, CP can be untied from OFDM with a marginal increase in SNR, thus saving priceless bandwidth.

articleTitle: A novel way of uniform amplitude generation for calibration and testing of high-resolution nuclear spectroscopy systems
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: This paper presents a new method of uniform amplitude generation for calibration and testing of high-resolution nuclear spectroscopy systems using a new method of DAC interpolation. The uniform amplitude generator (UAG) is designed to generate pulses whose amplitude can be controlled in steps of 10 μV in the range of 0 to 10V. The designed circuit is simulated using Multisim v14.0 software. It is suitable to calibrate the spectroscopy systems with the resolution of as high as 13-bit. The uniform amplitude generator (UAG) is also modified using a sliding technique which slides the pulses in steps of 1 μV to make it capable for testing spectroscopy systems with resolution of up to 16-bit.

articleTitle: Optimal Force Control and Analysis of Soft Pneumatic Actuator
publicationTitle: 2019 2nd International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Instrumentation and Control Technologies (ICICICT)
abstract: Soft body parts provide increased adaptability and robustness, are highly compliant and exploiting the material properties can aid in faster and effective systems. For a robotic hand to achieve similar precision levels of a human hand, the robotic hand must not only perform an ideal grasp of the object in its work-space but must also include the competence to detect the slippage of the object in hand. While there is research on a control system for a soft gripper, there is almost none for a gripper actuated with asymmetric bellow flexible pneumatic actuator (ABFPA). This paper aims to design and implement a control system for a soft actuated ABFPA gripper that can detect and avoid slip autonomously by integrating sensors into a four fingered gripper actuated by ABFPA. Three modes viz. pick, hold and place are controlled with the aid of distance sensor, force sensitive sensor and flex sensor. These modes are extensively presented in this paper.
